items.title: 北朝鮮、ＩＡＥＡ決議を一蹴　「二重基準」と反発
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Joyce Lee

[ソウル １９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Joyce Lee

[ソウル １９日 ロイター] - 北朝鮮の金正恩朝鮮労働党総書記の妹、金与正党総務部長は１９日、国際原子力機関（ＩＡＥＡ）が北朝鮮の核兵器開発を批判する決議を採択したことについて、二重基準だと反発した。

国営の朝鮮中央通信（ＫＣＮＡ）を通じて発表した談話で、ＩＡＥＡの「偏った視点と二重基準」が「国際的な核不拡散体制の崩壊を招く根本的な要因だ」と主張した。

また、ＩＡＥＡが米国の「あからさまな核拡散活動」や韓国の「原子力潜水艦導入計画」に目をつぶる一方、北朝鮮の「自衛的で正当な核活動」に対する決議を強引に採択したと批判した。

北朝鮮外務省もＫＣＮＡを通じて出した談話で決議を一蹴し、北朝鮮の核保有国としての地位は不可逆的で、核抑止力に裏打ちされていると表明した。

ＫＣＮＡはまた、金総書記が今週、主要な軍需工場を３日間視察したと伝えた。同氏は、防衛能力のあらゆる要素を近代化する取り組みが、軍の構成と手段に「大きな変化」をもたらしていると述べたという。

ＫＣＮＡによると、金総書記は１８日に平壌で開かれた宣伝担当者の研修でも講義を行い、現代の「思想戦」は旧来の手法を繰り返すのではなく、革新的で創造的、かつ攻撃的でなければならないと説いた。

items.title: AfD surge in eastern Germany makes some immigrants question whether they still belong
items.author: Amina Ismail, James Mackenzie
items.creator: Amina Ismail, James Mackenzie
items.summary: Shahd Najeeb still remembers the trauma of fleeing Islamic State fighters during Syria's civil war. More than a decade after finding refuge in Germany, she now fears she may no longer be welcome there.
items.body:
Shahd Najeeb still remembers the trauma of fleeing Islamic State fighters during Syria's civil war. More than a decade after finding refuge in Germany, she now fears she may no longer be welcome there.
"When I think about the time we left Syria, I still don't know how we managed to get through it," she told Reuters in her home in Rostock, on Germany's Baltic coast. "It was like a nightmare."
Najeeb and her husband, Mahmoud Hmouech, fled their home in Deir al-Zor in eastern Syria and rebuilt their lives in Germany, where he works in a barber shop and she serves meals in local schools. They have two young children.
"We are grateful to the German people for welcoming us and giving us peace and security," Hmouech said. "The work we do is a small way of showing our gratitude."
They are among more than 900,000 Syrians living in Germany, most of whom arrived as asylum seekers during the civil war.
But as the far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) gains support and migration returns to the centre of political debate, migrants say hostility towards foreigners is growing.
Reuters spoke to 20 people of migrant background in Rostock and the nearby city of Schwerin, many of whom have become German citizens and have lived in Germany for years.
Most said they had encountered more anti-immigrant abuse in recent years, ranging from muttered remarks to demands that they return to their countries of origin. One woman said a neighbour poured foul-smelling water on her from a balcony.
Their concerns come as the AfD gains momentum across eastern Germany.
In Najeeb and Hmouech's home state of Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, in the formerly communist east, opinion polls suggest the AfD is set to become the biggest party [USN:L1N44Y01V TEXT:"in an election"] on Sunday.
Earlier this month, the party, which wants to restrict immigration and talks about "remigration" - or sending foreigners back to their home countries - [USN:L1N44Y01V TEXT:"won its first major regional election"] in Saxony-Anhalt, another eastern state.
Several interviewees, including people working in healthcare, tourism, education and food services, said they would consider leaving Rostock or Schwerin if the climate continued to worsen.
'THIS COUNTRY IS FOR GERMANS' Sitting in the family's small apartment in northern Rostock, where their children's drawings cover one wall and toys are neatly stacked in corners of the living room, Najeeb spoke as her children, aged 6 and 4, played nearby.
Najeeb, who studied physics in Baghdad and later worked as a jewellery designer in Syria, recalled stopping at a grocery store after collecting her children from school when, she said, an elderly man in a wheelchair shouted that she did not belong in Germany.
"This country is for Germans," he yelled.
"The pain I experienced in Rostock is a new kind of pain that I have never felt before," Najeeb said.
"You feel the injustice because you have done nothing wrong. I worked hard to build a life for myself and then someone comes along and treats you like garbage," she said, her voice cracking.
She recalled her son asking: "Mama, why is he insulting you? What did you do to him?" Unsure how to explain, she told him the man was perhaps unwell.
LABOUR FORCE The AfD began as a eurosceptic party in 2013 and its anti-immigrant tone sharpened markedly after former Chancellor Angela Merkel's decision in 2015 to open Germany's borders temporarily, admitting around one million migrants and refugees, around a third of them Syrians fleeing the civil war.
Since then, it has grown from a fringe movement into Germany's most popular party, leading Chancellor Friedrich Merz's conservatives in national polls.
Leif-Erik Holm, the AfD's main candidate in Sunday's election, says he has "absolutely no objection" to immigration by skilled workers. He says those who should be deported are the more than 250,000 foreigners who have no legal right to stay in Germany.
But critics say the broader problem is the atmosphere created by rhetoric they say targets foreigners in general.
During a televised debate on Wednesday, Social Democrat state premier Manuela Schwesig accused the AfD of "causing widespread fear with its statements on remigration and workers from different cultural backgrounds."
"I think it's terrible that people who work here, who make their contribution and pay their taxes and social security contributions, are afraid and don't feel at ease," she said.
During the debate, she and Holm took a question from a design engineer concerned at the risk of losing a valued Moroccan draughtsman because of the racist insults he said he encountered regularly on the street.
Holm said it was "naturally a shame that there's such a mood". But he blamed the government for allowing illegal immigration and failing to deport more than a fraction of foreigners formally required to leave the country.
The debate carries [USN:L8N44Z0LM TEXT:"economic implications"] as well.
Around 50,000 people with a migration background work in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania. Economists have warned that like other eastern states with low birth rates and an ageing population, it will need more skilled workers.
According to data from Germany's labour office, around 316,000 Syrian nationals - not including Syrians who have acquired German nationality - work in Germany, most in full-time jobs that pay social security contributions.
Their unemployment rate is above 30%, but data show the longer people stay, the more likely they are to find work. Figures from 2023 indicate that among those who have been in Germany for seven years or longer, more than 60% have a job.
Many Syrians say they hope to return home if conditions improve. Others, including Najeeb and Hmouech, increasingly see their future in Germany.
Whether the AfD's rise changes that calculation remains an open question.
Hmouech says he does not want his children to grow up feeling rejected by the society they call home.
"At the end of the day, family comes first," he said.

items.title: アンソロピック、ＡＩ安全評価でアクセンチュアと提携
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [１８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[１８日 ロイター] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックは１８日、同社の最先端ＡＩモデルの独立評価実施に向け、コンサルティング大手アクセンチュアと提携すると発表した。両社は今後５年間にそれぞれ少なくとも１０億ドルを投じ、評価体制の構築に充てる。

アクセンチュアの専門ＡＩ部門が提携を主導し、アンソロピックのモデルの評価やレッドチーミング（疑似攻撃による脆弱性検証）を行うほか、アライメント（人間の意図との整合性）評価やモデルの安全対策の検証を実施する。

両社の投資は、アンソロピックが「組み込み型評価」と呼ぶ手法を後押しする。これは独立した評価者がＡＩ企業の内部で、社員に近いレベルのアクセス権を持って作業する仕組みだ。

アンソロピックは「組み込み型の評価者は企業がどのように運営されているかを評価し、安全性に関する約束を守っているかを検証し、盲点を特定することができる」と説明。さらに、評価者は事案を報告し、ＡＩがもたらす利益とリスクについて、より的確な情報を一般に提供することもできるとした。

アンソロピックとアクセンチュアは、他の評価機関やＡＩ開発企業とも同様の形で連携していく方針。

items.title: WTA roundup: Defending champ Iva Jovic returns to Guadalajara final
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Iva Jovic earned her lone career WTA Tour title last year at the Guadalajara Open. She is one win away from making it two straight at the same event.
items.body:
Iva Jovic earned her lone career WTA Tour title last year at the Guadalajara Open. She is one win away from making it two straight at the same event.
The 18-year-old Los Angeles native, seeded second, rolled to a 6-4, 6-1 victory over sixth-seeded Cristina Bucsa of Spain in the semifinals on Friday in Mexico.
Bucsa had plenty of opportunities in the match, but Jovic saved 11 of the 12 break points she faced. Jovic converted half of her eight break chances.
Standing in the way of Jovic successfully defending her crown will be Peyton Stearns, who is pursuing her third career tournament victory. The 24-year-old Cincinnati native downed eighth-seeded Liudmila Samsonova of Russia 7-6 (7), 6-2 in the other semifinal.
Stearns needed six set points to close the first set -- two with Samsonova serving at 5-6 and four more in the tiebreaker. In the second set, Stearns got an early break for a 2-1 edge and then pulled away.
Stearns' tournament wins occurred at Rabat, Morocco, in May 2024 and at Austin, Texas, in February 2026.
SP Open
Mary Stoiana, a 23-year-old Texas A&M product, saw her best WTA Tour event come to an end when she lost 6-4, 6-2 to second-seeded Paula Badosa of Spain in a quarterfinal match at Sao Paulo.
Badosa won 78% of her first-serve points while Stoiana managed just a 36% success rate on her first-serve points. The next opponent for Badosa will be Argentina's Nadia Podoroska, who edged the Netherlands' Suzan Lamens 7-6 (5), 3-6, 6-3.
In the other semifinal, fourth-seeded Anna Blinkova of France will oppose seventh-seeded Kaitlin Quevedo of Spain. Quevedo eliminated Serbia's Teodora Kostovic 6-3, 6-4, and Blinkova knocked off eighth-seeded Alina Charaeva of Armenia 6-4, 7-5.
--Field Level Media

items.author: ロイター

items.summary:
[１８日 ロイター] - 米グーグルの人工知能（ＡＩ）モデル「ジェミニ」が、サイバーセキュリティー能力の試験中にインターネットにアクセスし、他社システムに侵入していたことが分かった。同社のＡＩシステムがこうした行為を自律的に行った事例が確認されたのは初めて。

この事案は今年５月、サイバーセキュリティー評価を手がける独立系企業イレギュラーが実施したテスト中に発生した。

グーグルのセキュリティーエンジニアリング担当バイスプレジデント、ヘザー・アドキンス氏は声明で、
items.body:
[１８日 ロイター] - 米グーグルの人工知能（ＡＩ）モデル「ジェミニ」が、サイバーセキュリティー能力の試験中にインターネットにアクセスし、他社システムに侵入していたことが分かった。同社のＡＩシステムがこうした行為を自律的に行った事例が確認されたのは初めて。

この事案は今年５月、サイバーセキュリティー評価を手がける独立系企業イレギュラーが実施したテスト中に発生した。

グーグルのセキュリティーエンジニアリング担当バイスプレジデント、ヘザー・アドキンス氏は声明で、 標準的なテスト評価の過程でジェミニがオンライン上の公開情報を見つけ、認証情報を推測して、テストの範囲内だと判断した３つのウェブサイトにアクセスしたと説明。

「３つの組織にこの件を通知し、訓練パートナーと協力してテストプロセスの改善に取り組んだ」とした上で、「今回の事案は、強力なＡＩモデルが責任を持って行動するよう訓練することの重要性を浮き彫りにしている」と述べた。

イレギュラーの広報担当者は、今回の事案は他のＡＩ研究機関に影響を及ぼしたのと同じ問題に関わるもので、関連する全ての研究機関に７月下旬に通知したと述べた。

イレギュラーに関連する同様の事案は、メタ、アンソロピック、オープンＡＩも公表している。

items.title: Bravos logra primer triunfo en torneo mexicano de fútbol con doblete de colombiano Estupiñán
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Bravos de Ciudad Juárez logró el viernes su primer triunfo en el torneo Apertura del fútbol mexicano tras ganar por 2-0 a Tigres UANL con un doblete del colombiano Óscar Estupiñán en la novena jornada.
items.body:
Bravos de Ciudad Juárez logró el viernes su primer triunfo en el torneo Apertura del fútbol mexicano tras ganar por 2-0 a Tigres UANL con un doblete del colombiano Óscar Estupiñán en la novena jornada.
A pesar de su primera victoria, Bravos, que registraba ocho derrotas consecutivas, se mantiene en el último lugar de la tabla general con tres puntos. En tanto, el club de la Universidad Autónoma de Nuevo León se estancó en el decimoquinto sitio con siete unidades.
En el partido, disputado en el estadio Olímpico Benito Juárez, Bravos se puso en ventaja a los 66 minutos por la vía del tiro penal que anotó Estupiñán, después de que el centrocampista uruguayo Cesar Araújo cometió falta al panameño José Luis Rodríguez dentro del área.
El segundo gol de Bravos cayó a los 79 minutos con el doblete de Estupiñán, quien remató con la cabeza un centro enviado por Rodríguez.
En el otro partido del viernes, Puebla y Atlante empataron por 1-1 con goles del uruguayo Mathías Tomas y Walter Portales, respectivamente.
El sábado se jugarán los encuentros entre Atlas-Pumas UNAM, Atlético de San Luis-Necaxa, Monterrey-Cruz Azul y América-Guadalajara.
La jornada se completará el domingo cuando Pachuca enfrente a Tijuana, Toluca sea local ante Santos Laguna y León visite a Querétaro.

items.title: Mookie Betts belts 2 of Dodgers' 5 homers in rout of Giants
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Mookie Betts homered twice, including his 53rd career leadoff homer, and Josue De Paula hit a tiebreaking double to help the Los Angeles Dodgers produce an 8-2 victory over the visiting San Francisco Giants on Friday night.
items.body:
Mookie Betts homered twice, including his 53rd career leadoff homer, and Josue De Paula hit a tiebreaking double to help the Los Angeles Dodgers produce an 8-2 victory over the visiting San Francisco Giants on Friday night.
Betts also hit one of Los Angeles' four eighth-inning homers as the Dodgers socked five overall while winning for the 12th time in the 15 games. Max Muncy and Kyle Tucker hit back-to-back homers in the eighth, and Betts and Will Smith repeated the feat later in the frame.
Tyler Glasnow struck out a season-high 10 in six innings for Los Angeles (94-60), which trails the Milwaukee Brewers (96-58) by two games in the battle for the major leagues' best record.
Betts is tied with Hall of Famer Craig Biggio for the fourth-most leadoff homers all-time and is one behind third-place Alfonso Soriano. Betts has hit 33 for the Dodgers after producing 20 for the Boston Red Sox.
Hall of Famer Rickey Henderson tops the list with 81, and George Springer is second with 65.
Glasnow (5-1) gave up two runs, three hits and two walks. He is 7-1 in 10 career appearances (nine starts) against San Francisco.
Jung Hoo Lee homered and Jonah Cox had an RBI single as the Giants (64-90) fell for the fifth time in seven games.
With the score 2-2, Tucker walked to start the bottom of the sixth before Jason Foley (3-2) retired the next two batters. De Paula then laced a double into the right-center-field gap to put the Dodgers in front.
Los Angeles later played Home Run Derby off Giants left-hander Philip Abner in the eighth.
Muncy hit the third pitch of the inning over the wall in right-center. Two pitches later, Tucker also cleared the right-center fence to give Los Angeles a three-run lead.
Two outs later, De Paula walked before Betts homered to left-center, making it 7-2. Smith hit the second pitch in his at-bat over the wall in center.
Cesar Perdomo started for the Giants and gave up two runs and six hits over 4 2/3 innings. He walked three and struck out one.
Betts hit Perdomo's second pitch of the game over the fence in left-center to get the Dodgers started.
The Giants tied it in the second when Lee slammed a 2-2 pitch over the wall in right.
San Francisco moved ahead in the third as Scott Bandura singled and stole second to start the inning. There were two on and two outs later in the inning when Cox hit an RBI single to left.
In the fifth, De Paula and Betts singled to start the inning. One out later, Teoscar Hernandez delivered a single to right to tie it at 2.
--Field Level Media

items.title: EXCLUSIVE-アンソロピック、ＩＰＯ前に新モデル投入検討か　オープンＡＩに対抗
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Echo Wang　Krystal Hu　Milana Vinn

[１８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Echo Wang　Krystal Hu　Milana Vinn

[１８日 ロイター] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックが新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）を前に新型モデルの投入を検討していることが、関係筋３人の話で分かった。同業のオープンＡＩが「ＧＰＴ─６アストラ」を発表して以降勢いを増していることに対抗する狙いという。アンソロピックのダリオ・アモデイ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は業界全体の開発ペース減速を呼びかけたばかりだ。

今月リリースされたＧＰＴ─６アストラは企業の間で支持を広げており、一部の投資家はロイターに対し、企業向けＡＩツールの最有力プロバイダーとしてのアンソロピックの地位を再評価していると述べている。

関係者の１人によると、アンソロピックは新モデル投入を巡る検討の一環として、次期モデルの安全性を評価している。

同社の考え方に詳しい関係者らによると、金利上昇に伴い投資家が予想利益の実現時期をより重視するようになる中、新モデルのリリースに向けた投資と収益性強化の取り組みとのバランスをどう取るかといった問題などが議論されているという。

支出を巡るこうした議論は、ＡＩブームの中心にある企業に対し、持続可能なキャッシュフローをより早く生み出すよう求める圧力が強まっていることを浮き彫りにしている。金利上昇に加え、特に中国のオープンソース系ＡＩプロバイダーとの厳しい競争がその背景にある。

新モデル投入が実現すれば、競合他社との差別化要因である「安全性優先」というアイデンティティーを維持しつつ、オープンＡＩに対して企業向け市場での地位をどう守れるかが試される。

アンソロピックはコメントを控えた。

複数の関係者によると、同社はＩＰＯを１１月の米中間選挙後に先送りする可能性がある。選挙がＩＰＯに大きな影響を与えるとは見込まれていないという。

ロイターは今月、アンソロピックのＩＰＯに向けたマーケティング開始が早くても１０月中旬になる見込みだと報じた。

items.title: Inside China's AI race
items.summary: What does the AI race look like from inside China?
items.body:
Follow on Apple or Spotify . Listen on the Reuters app.
As the US and China race to dominate artificial intelligence, Reuters correspondents Eduardo Baptista and Laurie Chen say the two countries aren't even playing the same game. On this episode of On Assignment, they take us inside China's AI industry - from Beijing's push to weave AI into every corner of society, to the murky world of chip access, distillation and export controls. Hear what it takes to report on one of the most fast-moving industries on Earth, and why the answer to "who's winning" may depend entirely on how you define the race.

items.title: Asian Olympic boss says politicians need to stay out of sport at Nagoya Games
items.author: Ian Ransom
items.creator: Ian Ransom
items.summary: Olympic Council of Asia (OCA) President Sheikh Joaan bin Hamad Al Thani said on Saturday that politicians should not be involved in sports, following a diplomatic incident involving a Taiwan government official at the Asian Games.
items.body:
Olympic Council of Asia (OCA) President Sheikh Joaan bin Hamad Al Thani said on Saturday that politicians should not be involved in sports, following a diplomatic incident involving a Taiwan government official at the Asian Games.
Taiwan sport minister Lee Yang, a former Olympic badminton champion, was initially blocked from attending a flag-raising ceremony at the Games on Friday, triggering a standoff as the Taiwan delegation refused to participate in protest.
Lee was eventually permitted entry, with the ceremony taking place more than an hour after scheduled. Taiwan's cabinet complained Lee had been subject to "unreasonable obstruction" in a statement and that he had obtained the required access credentials.
Sheikh Joaan said at a press conference he was unaware of the incident but that politicians needed to stay out of sports at the quadrennial Games.
"I think that our focus here is on the athletes and on making sure that everyone, all the athletes, have the equal rights in competing and in having their freedom," the Qatari told reporters in Nagoya.
"So I don't think the politicians or politics should be involved in sports. That's my opinion."
OCA Director General Husain Al-Musallam added that the flag-raising ceremony was meant for the participants in the Games.
"(It's) not for the delegation from the ministry or from the government," he said.
Lee claimed back-to-back badminton gold medals in the men's doubles at the Tokyo and Paris Olympics.
The buildup to the Aichi-Nagoya Games has been overshadowed by complaints from national team delegations over organisational issues, including transport and the accommodations provided for athletes.
Sheikh Joaan defended the local organisers saying they had been solving accommodation issues as they arise.
"I think everything is hopefully being back on track," he said.
The organisational problems have underscored the massive size of the Games, which include a record 43 sports and 469 medal events, dwarfing the summer Olympics' 32 sports and 329 events.
The OCA defended the size of the programme at Nagoya, which will see the debut of "virtual" taekwondo while retaining breaking (breakdancing) and esports.
"We are very proud that the Asian Games (are) bigger than any other games with low cost," said Al-Musallam.
items.raw_description: Olympic Council of Asia (OCA) President Sheikh Joaan bin Hamad Al Thani said on Saturday that politicians should not be involved in sports, following a diplomatic incident involving a Taiwan government official at the Asian Games.

items.title: Yankees score 5 runs in first inning to take down D-backs
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Ben Rice and George Lombard Jr. homered and the New York Yankees scored five runs in the first inning to cruise to a 9-2 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks on Friday in Phoenix.
items.body:
Ben Rice and George Lombard Jr. homered and the New York Yankees scored five runs in the first inning to cruise to a 9-2 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks on Friday in Phoenix.
Lombard had two hits and three RBIs, and his two-run single capped the early five-run outburst against Eduardo Rodriguez (15-7), who walked three of the first four he faced.
Rice tripled and walked twice as the Yankees played without Aaron Judge, who will be placed on the injured list Saturday, retroactive to Thursday, with a right calf strain.
Gerrit Cole (9-9) gave up two runs on four hits in six innings. He struck out six, did not issue a walk, and retired 13 of the final 15 he faced after Corbin Carroll's two-run homer in the second made it 5-2.
Carroll added a double and Geraldo Perdomo and Nolan Arenado had two hits apiece for the D-backs, who have lost five of six as their NL wild-card chances fade.
The D-backs (80-74) are five games behind San Diego, Philadelphia and the Chicago Cubs (all 85-69) for the three NL wild-card spots. The Padres were the only one of the four to win Friday.
The Yankees (89-64) have won four of five and eight of 10.
The Yankees trail Tampa Bay by four games in the AL East, and the teams will meet in a four-game series in Yankee Stadium starting Tuesday. They are 5 1/2 games ahead of Boston for the first AL wild-card spot.
Rodriguez, on pace to post a career-low ERA, gave up five hits and seven runs in 5 1/3 innings, leaving after Lombard's homer made it 7-2 in the sixth. He struck out five and walked four.
The Yankees forced Rodriguez to use 45 pitches in their big first. Paul Goldschmidt walked to open the game and took third on Cody Bellinger's single before Heliot Ramos and Rice walked on 3-2 counts to force in the first run.
Amed Rosario followed with an RBI single and Ramos scored on a wild pitch before Lombard capped the inning with a two-run single.
Rice homered to lead off the third, Lombard homered in the sixth, and the Yankees turned an infield single and two Arizona errors into a two-run seventh to close the scoring.
--Field Level Media

items.title: 小泉防衛相、ヘグセス米国防長官と電話会談－安保協力の強化で一致
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 防衛省は19日、内閣改造で留任した小泉進次郎防衛相がヘグセス米国防長官と18日夜、電話会談したと発表した。日米同盟の抑止力・対処力を一層強化するため、幅広い安全保障協力を推進していくことで一致した。

小泉氏は、日本の防衛力強化に向けた安全保障関連3文書の改定に向けた取り組みについて説明。防衛力の変革に「これまで以上の速度と強度で取り組むべきとの切迫感を感じている」との認識を伝え、日米の連携をさらに深めたいとの考えを示した。

ヘグセス氏は小泉氏の留任に祝意を示し、今後の緊密な連携に期待を表明したという。両氏は近日中に対面で会うことでも一致した。

items.title: Bolivia scraps diesel subsidy to combat fuel shortages
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Bolivian President Rodrigo Paz on Friday announced the end of state diesel subsidies, shifting the country to a unified pricing model to help resolve chronic fuel shortages.
items.body:
Bolivian President Rodrigo Paz on Friday announced the end of state diesel subsidies, shifting the country to a unified pricing model to help resolve chronic fuel shortages.
Bolivia imports roughly 90% of its diesel, and the government spends approximately $55 million weekly on subsidies, according to Paz.
"Starting today, diesel will cost what it costs us to buy abroad," Paz said, citing rampant fuel smuggling and black-market reselling as key drivers of the weekly deficit.
The move replaces a dual-pricing system introduced in August that charged high-volume consumers 18 bolivianos ($2.60) per liter, while maintaining a subsidized rate of 9.80 bolivianos for others.
Paz said domestic prices will now track global benchmarks, dropping if international costs decline.
To offset the financial strain on households and key economic sectors, the administration unveiled targeted relief measures, including direct cash transfers and preferential credit lines.
items.raw_description: Bolivian President Rodrigo Paz on Friday announced the end of state diesel subsidies, shifting the country to a unified pricing model to help resolve chronic fuel shortages.

items.title: Padres blast Marlins to draw even in wild-card race
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Ty France clouted a three-run homer to cap a six-run fifth inning Friday night as the San Diego Padres stopped the visiting Miami Marlins 8-2 to forge a three-way tie atop the National League's wild-card standings.
items.body:
Ty France clouted a three-run homer to cap a six-run fifth inning Friday night as the San Diego Padres stopped the visiting Miami Marlins 8-2 to forge a three-way tie atop the National League's wild-card standings.
Winning for the 11th time in 12 games, San Diego (85-69) pulled even with the Chicago Cubs and Philadelphia, who both lost earlier Friday night. The Padres' magic number for clinching a playoff spot dropped to five.
Nick Pivetta (3-2) earned the win by working the first five innings, yielding four hits and a run with a walk and four strikeouts. Marlins reliever Cade Gibson (5-2) was tagged with the loss after yielding the first two runs in the game-changing fifth.
Xander Bogaerts led off with a double and reached third on Jake Cronenworth's single. Samad Taylor greeted reliever Tyler Zuber with a bunt single to fill the bases. After Ethan Salas' shallow fly ball netted Zuber an out, Fernando Tatis Jr. tied the game with an RBI single to right.
Dustin Harris put San Diego ahead to stay with a two-run single up the middle. After Manny Machado lined out, France jacked a hanging sweeper an estimated 388 feet to left for his 21st homer, a career high.
All that happened after Miami starter Tyler Phillips worked 3 2/3 scoreless innings, permitting only two hits and a walk while fanning three. He left with Miami holding a 1-0 edge after Agustin Ramirez lined a one-out homer to left in the third, his fifth.
The Marlins' other run came in the eighth via a two-out RBI single by Javier Sanoja that scored Otto Lopez, who doubled to left with one out. Ramirez collected three of their 10 hits, while Sanoja and Lopez had two each.
San Diego tacked on two more runs in its half of the eighth. Jackson Merrill led off by ripping his 26th homer of the year an estimated 432 feet to right. Three more singles, the last by Taylor, brought in Bogaerts.
Harris, France, Bogaerts, Cronenworth and Taylor each bagged two of the Padres' 12 hits.
--Field Level Media

items.title: New Zealand's Ravindra a doubt for India series after injury in promotional shoot
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: New Zealand all-rounder Rachin Ravindra dislocated his shoulder while filming a diving catch during a promotional shoot, making him a doubt for next month's Twenty20 series against India, the country's cricket board said on Saturday.
items.body:
New Zealand all-rounder Rachin Ravindra dislocated his shoulder while filming a diving catch during a promotional shoot, making him a doubt for next month's Twenty20 series against India, the country's cricket board said on Saturday.
The injury to Ravindra's right shoulder occurred in Auckland during a commercial shoot with Sky on Wednesday, New Zealand Cricket said in a statement.
"Initial assessments by medical specialists ... have cleared major structural damage, but Ravindra’s return to play timeline will be determined by his progress during the first weeks of his rehabilitation," it said.
Ravindra, 26, has represented New Zealand in 115 matches across all formats as a versatile batter who can slot into the top or middle order, and a left-arm finger-spinner.
He was New Zealand's highest run-scorer in the 50-over World Cup in 2023 and their highest wicket-taker in this year's T20 World Cup, where they reached the final.
"We are gutted for Rachin," said New Zealand's performance manager Mike Sandle.
"As with all commercial shoots involving our players, the activities were agreed in advance by all parties, with appropriate safety measures in place. It was a bit of a freak accident, and we’ll continue to review our processes around events like this in the future."
New Zealand will host India in five T20 matches from October 22, followed by five One-Day Internationals and two tests the following month.

items.title: Reports: Pistons, Ausar Thompson agree to five-year, $155 million extension
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Detroit Pistons and forward Ausar Thompson agreed to a five-year, $155 million extension on Friday, according to multiple media reports.
items.body:
The Detroit Pistons and forward Ausar Thompson agreed to a five-year, $155 million extension on Friday, according to multiple media reports.
The fully guaranteed deal will begin with the 2027-28 season, according to The Athletic. Thompson was entering the final season of the rookie contract he signed after Detroit selected him fifth overall in the 2023 NBA draft.
Still just 23 years old, Thompson is already widely regarded as one of the league's top defenders. He earned NBA All-Defensive first-team honors last season, becoming the first Pistons player to do so since Ben Wallace in 2005-06. Thompson also finished third in Defensive Player of the Year voting, behind winner Victor Wembanyama and runner-up Chet Holmgren.
In 73 games during the 2025-26 regular season, Thompson averaged 9.9 points, 5.7 rebounds, 3.1 assists, 2 steals and 0.9 blocks.
He added 8.2 points, 7.9 rebounds, 3.1 assists, 2.0 steals and 1.8 blocks per game during Detroit's 14-game run to the Eastern Conference semifinals. In doing so, he became the first player since Anthony Davis in 2020 to record at least 25 steals and 25 blocks in a single postseason.
Thompson and his twin, Houston Rockets forward Amen Thompson, are the first brothers in NBA history to each sign contracts worth at least $100 million.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Mets 1B Jared Young (concussion) out for season
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: New York Mets first baseman Jared Young was home recovering from a concussion on Friday, and the team shut him down for the remainder of the season.
items.body:
New York Mets first baseman Jared Young was home recovering from a concussion on Friday, and the team shut him down for the remainder of the season.
Young was knocked unconscious briefly after an on-field collision with teammate Nolan McLean on Thursday in the 3-0 loss to the visiting Philadelphia Phillies. He was taken off the field on a stretcher and transported to a hospital.
A day later, he was still dealing with short-term memory issues and headaches, Mets interim manager Andy Green said.
Green added that Young was doing "as good as could be expected and hoped for, given what we saw (Thursday) night. ... Everything we have heard has been really optimistic from a recovery standpoint, from a getting-back-on-the-field-eventually standpoint. I am relieved. I think everybody is."
Regarding Young's long-term prognosis, Green said, "Very optimistic about recovery and continuing to play going forward. There's no concerns in that space."
Young got hurt in the sixth inning on Thursday. McLean, the Mets' starting pitcher, moved toward first base to cover the bag on a dribbler hit by Justin Crawford. McLean was attempting to step over a nearly prone Young when he kneed Young in the head.
Young was down on the field for a long time before being loaded on a stretcher. He gave a thumbs-up to the crowd as he was carted off the field.
Crawford was safe on an infield single. McLean stayed in the game and struck out the next batter to end the inning, the last batter he faced.
The Mets placed him on the seven-day injured list on Friday and recalled Ronny Mauricio from Triple-A Syracuse.
Young, after going 0-for-2 on Thursday, finished the season with a .266 average, nine homers and 39 RBIs in 103 games.
Young, 31, began his major league career with the Chicago Cubs in 2022 and '23, then joined the Mets ahead of the 2025 season. In 147 career games, he has a .249 career average with 15 homers and 53 RBIs.
Mauricio, 25, hit .180 with one homer and two RBIs in 17 games for New York earlier this season.
--Field Level Media

By Ben Blanchard
TAIPEI, Sept 19 (Reuters) – US defence tech firm Anduril’s founder Palmer Luckey said on Saturday that President Donald Trump’s delay in approving arms sales to Taiwan is affecting its business and that he has discussed this with Trump.

The $14 billion package for Taiwan has been awaiting Trump’s approval for months. After a May summit in Beijing with Chinese President Xi Jinping, Trump said he was holding it in abeyance and described it as a “very good negotiating chip”.

China claims democratically governed Taiwan as its own, an assertion Taipei rejects. The issue of Taiwan is likely to be high on Xi’s agenda when he meets Trump in Washington next week.

Show Full Article

Speaking to reporters in Taipei where he attended a defence forum with Taiwan President Lai Ching-te, Luckey said he did not know the status of the arms package. 

“It’s definitely affecting the business in that our business with Taiwan would be in a different place if you had that $14 billion moving forward,” he said, declining to give details about what was being delayed for the company.

DRONES RESHAPE WARFARE

Anduril, whose Altius drone is used by Taiwan, has become one of Silicon Valley’s hottest defence bets as drones reshape warfare in Ukraine and the Middle East and Trump pushes the Pentagon to adopt cutting-edge technologies to counter China.  

Luckey, whom China sanctioned in December for selling weapons to Taiwan, said one of the problems in delaying the package was that it had a broader, longer-lasting impact. “It’s that as long as that’s stuck, you don’t have continued forward progress in other areas,” he said. 

The White House did not immediately respond to a request for comment outside office hours.

China has repeatedly told the US to stop selling weapons to Taiwan and has sanctioned numerous US companies that sell arms to the island. The US is bound by law to provide Taiwan with the means to defend itself, though Trump has called that commitment into question.

Luckey said he had discussed the issue of Taiwan arms sales with Trump, Vice President JD Vance and Secretary of State Marco Rubio. He said the administration was open to hearing from people on the issue but aware of the fallout that could come from selling more weapons to Taiwan, such as China using its leverage with rare earths crucial for tech companies.

“And so I’ve heard people say, shouldn’t he just approve the deal and damn the consequences? But he’s getting briefed by other people who are not me, and they’re saying, ‘If you do this, here’s what’s going to happen to American consumers’,” Luckey said.

“He has to weigh all of those things. He’s in a really difficult, difficult situation,” Luckey added, referring to Trump.

Lai, who shook hands with Luckey at the forum’s start, has made drones a central part of Taiwan’s military modernisation. 

Last year, Taiwan unveiled its first missile to be jointly made with a US company, Anduril’s Barracuda-500, an autonomous, low-cost cruise missile.

(Reporting by Ben Blanchard in Taipei; Editing by William Mallard)

items.title: Connor Prielipp fires 7 strong innings as Twins blank Angels
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Connor Prielipp allowed two hits over a career-high seven innings and fellow rookie Walker Jenkins went 3-for-4 with a home run as the Minnesota Twins registered a 3-0 victory over the Los Angeles Angels on Friday in Anaheim, Calif.
items.body:
Connor Prielipp allowed two hits over a career-high seven innings and fellow rookie Walker Jenkins went 3-for-4 with a home run as the Minnesota Twins registered a 3-0 victory over the Los Angeles Angels on Friday in Anaheim, Calif.
Prielipp (6-7) walked two and struck out eight. He left after throwing 92 pitches, 60 for strikes. Travis Adams pitched a 1-2-3 ninth inning to pick up his third save.
Jenkins, who began his career going 4-for-45, homered for the second straight game on his sixth consecutive hit in the series. Brooks Lee added two hits and a run for Minnesota (72-82), which evened the four-game series at one win apiece.
Jose Siri had two hits for Los Angeles (59-95). Grayson Rodriguez (4-8) gave up three runs on eight hits with no walks in 6 2/3 innings. He struck out four and threw 91 pitches, with 66 going for strikes.
Minnesota jumped out to a 2-0 lead in the first inning. Luke Keaschall was hit by a pitch to start the game and advanced to third on a single by Lee. Kody Clemens then hit into a fielder's choice with Keaschall getting thrown at home following a lengthy rundown that allowed Lee and Clemens to advance to second and third.
Ryan Jeffers followed with a sacrifice fly to drive in Lee, and Josh Bell drove in Clemens with a single to center.
Los Angeles nearly cut the lead in half in the sixth inning when Zach Neto led off with a long drive to left, but Emmanuel Rodriguez jumped up at the fence to rob him of a home run.
Jenkins then made it 3-0 in the seventh when he lined his third home run 357 feet off the foul pole netting in right.
The Angels loaded the bases with no outs against reliever Tommy Nance in the eighth on back-to-back singles by Christian Moore, snapping an 0-for-21 drought, and Wade Meckler and a walk to Neto. But Nance got out of the jam with consecutive strikeouts of Mike Trout and pinch hitter Josh Lowe followed by a lineout to left by Vaughn Grissom.
--Field Level Media

外交筋によると、アンソロピックの幹部も同会合に出席すると見込まれているが、まだ確定していないという。

複数のＡＩ業界幹部はここ数週間、ＡＩが近く自律的に進化し人間の制御を逃れる恐れがあると警告し、協調的な開発減速を呼びかけている。

South Korea justice nominee withdraws in Lee's second cabinet setback as polls slide

Kim Seung-won's exit is the latest fallout from President Lee Jae Myung's cabinet reshuffle in late August.

South Korean Justice Minister nominee Kim Seung-won speaks during his confirmation hearing at the National Assembly in Seoul. REUTERS/Kim Hong-Ji/File Photo

SEOUL: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung 's nominee for justice minister withdrew from consideration on Saturday (Sep 19), the second of Lee's cabinet picks to step aside this month as his approval ratings slump.
Kim Seung-won's exit follows the withdrawal of Yong Hye-in as nominee for gender-equality minister on Sunday, in the latest fallout from Lee's cabinet reshuffle in late August.
Kim, who said he did not want to add any burden to Lee's administration, criticised a conservative lawmaker who had accused him of lobbying regulators over a drug trial and of financial irregularities. Kim has denied the allegations.
"I gravely accept that I did not meet the public's expectations, and I will deeply reflect on my shortcomings," Kim told a press conference.
A Gallup Korea poll released on Friday put Lee's public approval at 37 per cent, the lowest since he took office in June 2025, a decline pollsters have partly linked to criticism over his personnel appointments.
At a press conference on Friday, Lee acknowledged shortcomings in his administration's screening of nominees. 
"We are currently working to reexamine our personnel system," the president said.

Source: Reuters/ht

items.title: Kit blunder forces India to change Asian Games flagbearer
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: India have replaced their male flagbearer in Saturday's Asian Games opening ceremony in Nagoya, Japan, because the original choice, Tajinderpal Singh Toor, has not received his official ceremonial kit and cannot attend the event, media reports said.
items.body:
India have replaced their male flagbearer in Saturday's Asian Games opening ceremony in Nagoya, Japan, because the original choice, Tajinderpal Singh Toor, has not received his official ceremonial kit and cannot attend the event, media reports said.
Toor, who is aiming for his third straight Asian Games gold in shot put, will be replaced by kabaddi player Pawan Sehrawat as the male flagbearer. Shooter Manu Bhaker, who won two bronze medals at the Paris Olympics, is the female flagbearer.
“I'm told that my kit will reach at 3 p.m. at the airport. Reaching the opening ceremony venue after collecting my kit from airport on time will be very difficult. So, I've told IOA (Indian Olympic Association) that I'm not coming for opening ceremony,” news agency PTI quoted Toor as saying.
"My kit is lying in India ... IOA told me yesterday about me becoming flagbearer. Otherwise my coach, who reached here yesterday, could've picked it up for me."
The IOA said in a statement that 31-year-old Toor would not be able to be India's flagbearer "due to a technical issue".

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン １８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン １８日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は、中国の習近平国家主席による来週の訪米に際し、首都ワシントン郊外のアンドルーズ空軍基地で直接出迎える意向だ。米政府高官が１８日、記者団に明らかにした。

米大統領が外国首脳を空港で出迎えるのは異例。

高官によると、ホワイトハウスでの歓迎式典、ローズガーデンでの閲兵式、夜には夕食会が予定されている。 

夕食会にはアマゾン・ドット・コム創業者のジェフ・ベゾス氏、アルファベットのスンダー・ピチャイ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）、オープンＡＩのサム・アルトマンＣＥＯ、アップルのティム・クック会長、テスラのイーロン・マスクＣＥＯ、エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアンＣＥＯら複数のテクノロジー企業幹部が出席する見通しだという。

高官によると、今回の訪問では貿易、世界経済へのレアアース（希土類）供給、人工知能（ＡＩ）などが議題となる見込み。

items.title: Sal Frelick's 10th-inning RBI sends Brewers past Orioles
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Sal Frelick singled home a 10th-inning run and the visiting Milwaukee Brewers pulled out a 6-5 victory against the Baltimore Orioles on Friday in the opener of a three-game series.
items.body:
Sal Frelick singled home a 10th-inning run and the visiting Milwaukee Brewers pulled out a 6-5 victory against the Baltimore Orioles on Friday in the opener of a three-game series.
There was late-inning drama for both teams before Chad Patrick retired the Orioles in order in the bottom of the 10th for his sixth save. Trevor Megill (3-3) was the winning pitcher despite a blown save.
Milwaukee's Jackson Chourio and Baltimore's Pete Alonso hit three-run homers early in the game, and then there were five consecutive innings with no scoring.
With the score 3-3, the Brewers (96-58) took the lead with two runs in the top of the ninth. William Contreras delivered a run-scoring double off reliever Rico Garcia, and Christian Yelich hit a two-out RBI single against Grant Wolfram (6-4).
The bottom of the ninth began with Gunnar Henderson's single and Coby Mayo's double off Megill. Samuel Basallo and Christian Encarnacion-Strand each followed with a sacrifice fly to even the score at 5-5.
Chourio and Brice Turang both finished with two hits for the National League Central champion Brewers, who totaled 10 hits while winning for the eighth time in 10 games.
Henderson and Mayo both collected three hits for the Orioles (75-79). Colton Cowser added two hits to Baltimore's 12-hit attack.
The Orioles left 12 runners on base as their three-game winning streak ended and they endured a damaging loss in their quest for an American League wild card. Baltimore trails the Chicago White Sox (78-76) by three games for the last wild-card slot with eight games to go.
Neither starting pitcher lasted long.
Cade Povich worked 3 2/3 innings for Baltimore, surrendering three runs on five hits with two walks and three strikeouts.
Dustin May of the Brewers logged 2 1/3 innings, giving up three runs on six hits and one walk with four strikeouts.
Alonso socked his 38th homer of the season and his fifth in nine games. His RBI total rose to 105.
The Brewers threatened in the eighth with three walks, but they stranded the bases loaded on Cooper Pratt's flyout.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Rangers beat Blue Jays, gain ground in playoff race
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Corey Seager capped a four-run second inning with an RBI double as the Texas Rangers opened a three-game series against the Toronto Blue Jays with a 7-1 win on Friday in Arlington, Texas.
items.body:
Corey Seager capped a four-run second inning with an RBI double as the Texas Rangers opened a three-game series against the Toronto Blue Jays with a 7-1 win on Friday in Arlington, Texas.
Texas (77-77) drew 10 walks and moved into a first-place tie with the Houston Astros in the American League West.
Toronto (76-78) fell one game behind the Rangers and two games back of the Chicago White Sox (78-76) for the final AL Wild Card spot.
Jake Burger had two RBIs for the Rangers, who won for the fifth time in their last six games.
Trevor Williams (2-0) closed the game by striking out four batters over four scoreless innings for the win.
Myles Straw had two hits with an RBI for the Blue Jays, who committed three errors and lost for the third time in their last four games.
Texas took a 4-0 lead in the second inning against Dylan Cease (11-6), who issued back-to-back walks before Lopez singled to load the bases. With one out, shortstop Ernie Clement made a throwing error on Evan Carter fielder's choice grounder, allowing two runs to score.
Another run scored on Ezequiel Duran's sacrifice fly before Seager capped the rally with an RBI double to right field.
Cease allowed four runs (one earned) on three hits over 2 2/3 innings. He walked six and struck out three.
Toronto got on the board against Kumar Rocker in the fifth inning when Josh Smith scored from second on Straw's one-out double.
Rocker gave up one run on three hits with two walks and two strikeouts over 4 1/3 innings.
The Rangers added to their lead with a run in the fifth when Brandon Nimmo scored on Burger's sacrifice fly.
Toronto's control issues surfaced again with one out in the sixth inning, when Langford drew a bases-loaded walk from Brendon Little.
The Blue Jays escaped further damage when Jose Rodriguez replaced Little for his major league debut and recorded two quick outs.
Texas tacked on a run in the eighth inning on Burger's RBI double against Joe Mantiply.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Trump says son will repay Russian oligarch over wedding party controversy
items.author: Bloomberg
items.summary: Trump said his son Donald Trump Jr. told him he was repaying the Russian businessman, while a person familiar with the matter also confirmed a repayment but gave no details ...
items.body: By Catherine Lucey and Josh Wingrove President Donald Trump said his son, Donald Trump Jr., told him he was repaying a Russian oligarch for a wedding party, seeking to tamp down on an incident that has spurred fresh ethical questions. “I asked about it. He said, ‘No, I’m paying him back, Dad,’ so, and that was a while ago, so I heard he’s paying him,” Trump told reporters Friday in the Oval Office when asked about the controversy.  “I understand that Don’s paid him back,” he said at one point. Trump sought to downplay the matter, casting the oligarch as a friend of his son’s and saying it was common for those who know a bride or groom to pay for a wedding party. “A person that he knows, I guess a friend of his, gave him a wedding party. That’s very common. I’ve heard of many people giving wedding parties,” Trump said.  A person familiar with the matter also said the president’s son had made a repayment, though the total sum and timing are not clear. The person spoke on condition of anonymity to discuss the transaction. The president’s daughter-in-law, Bettina Trump, said in an Instagram post earlier this week that the couple had a private marriage ceremony in May, which was followed by a celebration the following weekend in the Bahamas. The second event was hosted by Umar Kremlev, Bettina Trump said. ProPublica reported this week that Kremlev bankrolled the Bahamas celebration, shelling out hundreds of thousands of dollars to rent a private island and put on a fireworks show, among other expenses. Kremlev is a Russian oligarch with ties to President Vladimir Putin and has been personally sanctioned by Ukraine over those connections. The top Democrat on the House Oversight Committee is probing Kremlev’s role in funding the celebrations. The wedding party is one of only a number of ethical flashpoints during Trump’s second term as the president’s family has continued to pursue business ventures. Trump has also at times mixed his official and personal duties, drawing scrutiny. Last weekend, he attended the Amgen Irish Open at one of his family’s golf resorts in Ireland.

items.title: US fashion council CEO Kolb resigns after clash with runway show protesters
items.author: Ruchika Khanna
items.creator: Ruchika Khanna
items.summary: Steven Kolb resigned as head of the Council of Fashion Designers of America on Friday, days after coming under fire for physically restraining animal rights activists at a New York Fashion Week runway show.
items.body:
Steven Kolb resigned as head of the Council of Fashion Designers of America on Friday, days after coming under fire for physically restraining animal rights activists at a New York Fashion Week runway show.
"After twenty years leading the CFDA, I have made the difficult decision to step down as CEO and President," Kolb said in a post on his Substack.
The CFDA, the leading US fashion-industry trade group and organizer of New York Fashion Week, said on Tuesday that Kolb was on leave pending a full review by the council's board, after he said he was taking a voluntary leave.
On Sunday, Kolb [USN:L6N4570YE TEXT:"grabbed at least two activists"] protesting H&M-owned COS's (HMb.ST) use of wool during a runway show. He pinned one protester to the ground and covered her mouth with his hand, according to videos viewed by Reuters that circulated widely online.
Kolb apologized on Monday, saying he planned to meet with People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals, which had organized the protest.
"There is no justification for physically restraining another person," he said at the time. "Security should have handled the situation, and I should have stepped back."
Kolb's physical confrontation with the activists led to a widespread backlash, with PETA on Sunday saying his actions "show how top people in fashion use violence to silence people" advocating for animal rights.
The CFDA board, led by Thom Browne and including designers such as Vera Wang, Ralph Lauren and Michael Kors, said in an Instagram post that it respected Kolb's decision to step down and thanked him for his years of service.
The CFDA did not name a successor.

items.title: Lazaro Montes’ 9th-inning homer lifts Mariners past Rockies
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Lazaro Montes homered leading off the top of the ninth, J.P. Crawford also went deep and the Seattle Mariners beat the host Colorado Rockies 5-4 in Denver on Friday night.
items.body:
Lazaro Montes homered leading off the top of the ninth, J.P. Crawford also went deep and the Seattle Mariners beat the host Colorado Rockies 5-4 in Denver on Friday night.
Randy Arozarena finished with three hits, Carlos Vargas (2-0) recorded one out for the win for Seattle (72-82) and Andres Munoz earned his 28th save.
With the game tied 4-all, Montes launched a 426-foot homer into the second deck in right field off Jordan Romano (0-4). Cole Carrigg led off the bottom of the ninth with a single and stole second but was caught stealing third. Munoz then fanned Mickey Moniak to end the game.
Carrigg, Connor Norby and Jake McCarthy had three hits apiece and Ezequiel Tovar contributed two hits for Colorado (56-98).
Down 3-2, the Rockies rallied in the sixth. Tovar reached on a one-out single, chasing starter Bryan Woo, and then stole second against reliever Gabriel Speier. McCarthy tripled to center to tie it and scored on Norby's single to give Colorado the lead.
Seattle tied it in the seventh when Michael Arroyo, who led off with a double, scored on Dominic Canzone's sacrifice fly.
Woo allowed three runs on 10 hits in 5 1/3 innings.
The Mariners jumped on Colorado starter Gabriel Hughes in the first inning. Crawford hit his 18th career leadoff homer to open the night and Arozarena and Canzone hit consecutive doubles to put runners on second and third.
Hughes struck out the next two before Josh Naylor ripped a single to right to drive in two runs. The rookie right-hander settled down after that single, retiring 11 in a row until a one-out walk to Brock Rodden in the fifth. He left after Arozarena's two-out infield single.
Hughes allowed three runs on five hits and fanned six in 4 2/3 innings.
The Rockies answered with a run in the bottom of the first on Carrigg's RBI single but squandered a leadoff triple from Moniak in the second. They scored again with two outs in the fourth when Tovar doubled and came home on McCarthy's single.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Tigers wipe out 6-run deficit, knock White Sox out of first place
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Dillon Dingler delivered the go-ahead single and Riley Greene followed with a two-run homer in a five-run eighth inning as the visiting Detroit Tigers stormed back from six runs down to beat the Chicago White Sox 11-8 on Friday.
items.body:
Dillon Dingler delivered the go-ahead single and Riley Greene followed with a two-run homer in a five-run eighth inning as the visiting Detroit Tigers stormed back from six runs down to beat the Chicago White Sox 11-8 on Friday.
The loss dropped Chicago (78-76) one game behind Cleveland (79-75) in the American League Central after the Guardians beat the Athletics 5-3 on Friday.
Detroit trailed 8-2 before scoring nine unanswered runs, capped by the eighth-inning explosion. Hao-Yu Lee tied the game with a two-run homer off Sean Newcomb (2-5). Three batters later, Dingler singled to right off Bryan Hudson to put the Tigers ahead. Greene followed with a blast to right field.
Lee went 4-for-5 with three RBIs and two runs, and teammate Kevin McGonigle finished 2-for-5 with four RBIs.
The White Sox jumped on Tigers starter Andrew Sears for six runs in the first after Detroit struck for a run in the top of the inning. Chicago loaded the bases with two walks and an error before a wild pitch scored Tommy Pham. An error by Lee at third base brought home another run before Colson Montgomery ripped a three-run double to right field for a 5-1 lead.
Sears was replaced by Beau Brieske, and Miguel Vargas followed with an RBI double.
After McGonigle hit an RBI single in the top of the third, Vargas crushed his 32nd home run, a two-run shot in bottom of the third that pushed the lead to 8-2.
The Tigers (73-81) started chipping away in the fifth. McGonigle ripped a bases-clearing triple to deep right-center field to make it 8-5 before Lee's RBI double in the sixth pulled Detroit within two.
Sears lasted just two-thirds of an inning, allowing one hit and six runs, none earned, while walking three. White Sox starter David Sandlin gave up five runs on seven hits over four-plus innings, walking one and striking out four.
Tigers reliever Drew Sommers (2-4) struck out five in two scoreless, hitless innings. Kenley Jansen worked a 1-2-3 ninth for his 21st save.
--Field Level Media

items.title: China investigates Meituan and Alibaba units for suspected antitrust violations
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: China's market regulator is investigating Meituan unit Beijing Sankuai Information Technology for suspected violations of unfair competition laws, the country's official CCTV broadcaster reported on Saturday.
items.body:
China's market regulator is investigating Meituan (3690.HK) unit Beijing Sankuai Information Technology for suspected violations of unfair competition laws, the country's official CCTV broadcaster reported on Saturday.
China has been cracking down on monopolistic behaviour, most recently fining Trip.com (9961.HK) [USN:L1N43R00Q TEXT:"5.2 billion yuan"] ($776.41 million) over what the regulator said was its online hotel-booking monopoly, as Beijing struggles to bolster consumption amid a slowing economy.
The Beijing branch of the State Administration for Market Regulation said Alibaba (9988.HK) unit Hangzhou Taomei Aviation Services, Tongcheng Network Technology and Tujia Online Information Technology (Tianjin) were also subject to investigation after preliminary findings, according to CCTV.
Tongcheng and Tujia said in posts on their official WeChat accounts that their operations are normal and that they are cooperating with authorities. Meituan said in a post on its official website that it will cooperate with authorities.
Hangzhou Taomei said in an official WeChat post it is cooperating with regulators.
The China Hotel Association said on Saturday that Beijing's branch of SAMR has started investigating four online hotel and travel booking platforms for unfair competitive practices, without identifying the operators of the platforms.
The statement on the association's website said the move followed a meeting held by the SAMR and the Ministry of Culture and Tourism for the online booking industry.
($1 = 6.6975 Chinese yuan)

items.title: Cade Cavalli reaches 200 strikeouts as Nationals rout Cardinals
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Cade Cavalli pitched five scoreless innings and recorded the 200th strikeout of his first full major league season Friday night, leading the Washington Nationals to a 9-1 victory against the host St. Louis Cardinals.
items.body:
Cade Cavalli pitched five scoreless innings and recorded the 200th strikeout of his first full major league season Friday night, leading the Washington Nationals to a 9-1 victory against the host St. Louis Cardinals.
Cavalli, who agreed to a four-year contract extension with the Nationals earlier in the day that could be worth up to $70 million, allowed four hits and struck out six. He is the seventh pitcher with at least 200 strikeouts so far this season.
With his ace staked to a big lead thanks in part to a two-run home run by Dylan Crews and a two-run double by Yohandy Morales, manager Blake Butera pulled Cavalli after he threw 73 pitches.
Cavalli (13-5) earned strikeout No. 200 on the final pitch of his outing, a changeup on the inside corner that froze JJ Wetherholt without a swing to end the fifth. Cavalli gave a smile and pumped his fist as he walked off the field with catcher Harry Ford.
He has posted a 1.90 ERA in 12 second-half starts.
Cavalli is the first Nats pitcher to reach 200 strikeouts in a season since Patrick Corbin, Max Scherzer and Stephen Strasburg did it in the 2019 World Series season.
Cavalli's extension guarantees him $47 million and could be worth up to $70 million if the Nationals exercise their 2031 team option.
The Nationals (72-82) pushed three runs across in the first inning, keyed by an RBI single from CJ Abrams and a run-scoring fielder's choice grounder from Brady House.
Abrams also stole second base in the first to become the first Nats player since Alfonso Soriano in 2006 to reach 30 homers and 30 steals in the same season.
Crews' 12th homer of the year came during a four-run third against Kyle Leahy (10-5). Leahy allowed seven runs -- six earned -- along with five hits and three walks over three innings.
Brad Lord followed Cavalli with two scoreless frames, and the Cardinals (75-79) scored their lone run against right-hander Jack Sinclair in the eighth on an RBI grounder by Ivan Herrera.
Josiah Gray pitched a one-hit ninth for Washington, which has won five of six.
--Field Level Media

items.title: トランプ米大統領、グリーンランド巡りデンマークと安全保障合意
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： トランプ米大統領は18日、デンマーク自治領のグリーンランドの安全保障について米国に「恒久的な管理権」を与えることでデンマークと合意したと明らかにした。大西洋を挟む同盟関係に亀裂を生じさせた一連の問題は、ひとまず収束する。

トランプ氏は18日、合意の全容をすぐには明らかにしなかったが、デンマークとグリーンランドの首脳は、来週の国連総会で合意文書に署名する見通しを示した。

トランプ氏がアピールした今回の合意は、グリーンランドの領有を目指してきた従来の姿勢から大幅に後退した内容とみられる。グリーンランドを巡るトランプ氏の度重なる要求は米国と欧州の間に不信をあおり、第2次世界大戦終結以降、北大西洋条約機構（NATO）が直面した最も深刻な問題の一つとなった。

トランプ氏はSNSで合意を発表し、米国が抱える「数多くの懸念の全て」に対処する内容で、米国には「一切費用がかからない」と説明。「グリーンランドと米国の安全を確保し、防衛するためにグリーンランドで必要なことを行う完全な能力を、米国は恒久的に持つことになる」と投稿した。

新たな合意によって、グリーンランドを巡る現在の安全保障上の取り決めが実質的にどう変わるのかは明らかではない。米国は以前から、同島への部隊配備の規模を決める上で極めて大きな裁量を持っており、実際には数十年にわたって駐留規模を縮小してきた。

米国は1951年、グリーンランドへの軍部隊派遣を巡りデンマークと初めて合意した。この協定では、米国が計画についてデンマーク政府と協議し、通知することが定められたが、それさえも通知以上のことをほとんど必要としない、形式的な条件とみなされていた。協定に有効期限はない。

米政府当局者は匿名を条件に新たな合意内容について、NATO非加盟国がグリーンランドに軍事基地を設置することを明示的に禁止し、米国への脅威とみなされる同島への投資を制限するものだと説明した。また、必要に応じて米国がグリーンランドの基地数を増やすことも認めるという。

items.title: Famed Inter Milan and Italy forward Mazzola dies at 83
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Former Italy forward Sandro Mazzola, who spent all 17 years of his senior career at Inter Milan, has died at the age of 83, the club said on Saturday.
items.body:
Former Italy forward Sandro Mazzola, who spent all 17 years of his senior career at Inter Milan, has died at the age of 83, the club said on Saturday.
Mazzola, considered a club icon at Inter, scored 158 goals in 565 appearances, helping them win four Serie A titles and two European Cups. He was part of the Italy side that won the Euros in 1968 and reached the World Cup final in Mexico two years later.
"Sandro Mazzola was one of the greatest footballers in history. Not only in the history of the Nerazzurri," Inter said in a statement on their official website, using a nickname for the team. "He was Inter’s history: he joined the club as a boy and never left it."
Mazzola was 6 years old when his father Valentino, also an Italy international, died in the Superga air disaster, a plane crash in May 1949 that killed the entire Torino team on their way back from a match in Lisbon.
At 18, Mazzola made his senior debut when Inter fielded their youth side in a match against Juventus, after the Italian federation overturned a decision awarding Inter a 2-0 victory following a pitch invasion by Juventus fans and ordered a replay.
Mazzola, who had been a club mascot at Inter as a child, finished a school exam before travelling to Turin, where he scored Inter's only goal from a penalty in a 9-1 defeat to Juventus.
He quickly became a first-team regular, helping Inter win their first European Cup in 1964 by scoring a brace as they beat Real Madrid 3-1 in the final. He played a key role when Inter won the title again the next season.
Mazzola retired as a player in 1977 and later served as Inter's sporting director. He also became the sporting director of Torino, his father's club.
"The star with the moustache shone on the pitch, and still does today. As he often said, he had one final wish: to be remembered as a good man, someone who keeps fighting even when winning is impossible, like in that 9-1," Inter said.

items.title: Braves clinch playoff berth against Astros as Tyler Mahle stars
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Michael Harris II, Ronald Acuna Jr. and Matt Olson slugged two-run home runs, and deadline acquisition Tyler Mahle continued his exceptional pitching for the visiting Atlanta Braves, who secured a postseason berth with a 6-2 victory over the Houston Astros on Friday.
items.body:
Michael Harris II, Ronald Acuna Jr. and Matt Olson slugged two-run home runs, and deadline acquisition Tyler Mahle continued his exceptional pitching for the visiting Atlanta Braves, who secured a postseason berth with a 6-2 victory over the Houston Astros on Friday.
The Braves (90-64) lowered their magic number to clinch the National League East to three over the Philadelphia Phillies, who suffered a 6-3 road loss to the New York Mets earlier on Friday. The Braves have qualified for the postseason eight times over the last nine seasons.
Harris provided Mahle a 2-0 lead when he followed a one-out single by Matt Olson with an opposite-field blast to left off Astros starter Peter Lambert (8-10) in the top of the fourth inning. Harris (3-for-5) drove a first-pitch slurve from Lambert 367 feet for his 26th homer of the year.
Lambert retired the Braves in order in the first and second innings, and stranded baserunners in the third, fourth and fifth. He departed with one out in the sixth after allowing singles to Olson and Harris before loading the bases with a walk to Ozzie Albies. Astros reliever AJ Blubaugh relieved Lambert and left the bases loaded, but Lambert extended his winless streak to 12 consecutive starts after allowing two runs, six hits and one walk while striking out six batters.
Acuna followed a one-out walk from Drake Baldwin with his 19th home run in the seventh, a 369-foot line drive to left off Blubaugh that extended the lead to 4-1. With one out in the ninth, Olson bashed his 40th homer the opposite way to left off Astros reliever Enyel De Los Santos.
Mahle (7-10) improved to 4-1 with a 1.28 ERA over eight starts since his acquisition from the Giants. He allowed one run on three hits and one walk with six strikeouts over six innings.
Yordan Alvarez doubled leading off the fourth and scored when Isaac Paredes followed with a single to center. Alvarez finished 1-for-2 with two walks and had just one plate appearance with a runner on base. Paredes followed the second Alvarez walk in the eighth with an RBI single that plated LaMonte Wade Jr.
The Astros (77-77) threatened later in the eighth, but Acuna made a spectacular diving catch that retired Jose Altuve and stranded two baserunners.
--Field Level Media

items.title: South Korea justice nominee withdraws in Lee's second cabinet setback as polls slide
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung's nominee for justice minister withdrew from consideration on Saturday, the second of Lee's cabinet picks to step aside this month as his approval ratings slump.
items.body:
South Korean President Lee Jae Myung's nominee for justice minister withdrew from consideration on Saturday, the second of Lee's cabinet picks to step aside this month as his approval ratings slump.
Kim Seung-won's exit follows the withdrawal of Yong Hye-in as nominee for gender-equality minister on Sunday, in the latest fallout from Lee's cabinet [USN:L1N44R00D TEXT:"reshuffle"] in late August.
Kim, who said he did not want to add any burden to Lee's administration, criticised a conservative lawmaker who had accused him of lobbying regulators over a drug trial and of financial irregularities. Kim has denied the allegations.
"I gravely accept that I did not meet the public's expectations, and I will deeply reflect on my shortcomings," Kim told a press conference.
A Gallup Korea poll released on Friday put Lee's public approval at 37%, the lowest since he took office in June 2025, a decline pollsters have partly linked to criticism over his personnel appointments.
At a press conference on Friday, Lee acknowledged shortcomings in his administration's screening of nominees. "We are currently working to reexamine our personnel system," the president said.

items.title: Indigenous, civil-society groups sue Prabowo over forest fire response
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A group of indigenous and civil-society organisations in Indonesia's West Kalimantan has filed a class-action lawsuit against President Prabowo Subianto and other authorities over their handling of forest fires in the region, its lawyer said on Saturday.
items.body:
A group of indigenous and civil-society organisations in Indonesia's West Kalimantan has filed a class-action lawsuit against President Prabowo Subianto and other authorities over their handling of forest fires in the region, its lawyer said on Saturday.
Below are more details:
The case was registered at the Pontianak court in West Kalimantan with the first hearing scheduled for October 7, the court filing shows.
"This lawsuit was filed in response to the West Kalimantan public's concerns over the government's negligence and failure to prevent and tackle forest and land fires that recur every year," Glorio Sanen, the plaintiffs' lawyer told Reuters on Saturday.
The presidential office did not immediately respond to request for comment.
The plaintiffs are West Kalimantan chapter of the Indigenous Peoples Alliance of the Archipelago, West Kalimantan branch of Catholic Youth, Perkumpulan Laman Punyung Indonesia and an individual, Sisilius Rami, the filing shows.
Indonesia is battling its most intense [USN:L1N45807M TEXT:"wildfires"] in 11 years and the government has warned that the fires could continue until November this year.
In 2016, a lawsuit was [USN:KCN1UI1DA TEXT:"brought"] by seven Indonesian residents against then-President Joko Widodo, his cabinet ministers and local governments over their handling of forest fires in 2015.
After initially winning at the district court, the decision on 2016's lawsuit was overturned when the Supreme Court granted the government's petition for judicial review in 2022, according to media reports.

items.title: Trump signs Russia sanctions bill, opens door to new tariffs on oil buyers
items.author: Bloomberg
items.summary: The new law gives Trump authority to impose tariffs of up to 100 per cent on major buyers of Russian energy, including India and China, as Washington seeks to pressure Moscow ...
items.body: By Erik Wasson President Donald Trump on Friday signed into law a Russia sanctions bill that now empowers him to impose tariffs on countries that purchase Russian petroleum products. The new sanctions authority has been eagerly anticipated by Ukrainian officials hoping for a tangible sign of US support in its fight against a Russian invasion. The war, now in its fifth year, is in a critical phase of escalation.  The top five purchasers of Russian petroleum products — a list that includes China, India and US allies like Turkey — could be hit with broad new tariffs. Opponents of the bill argue it could open the door to tariffs on the entire European Union whose members also purchase Russian energy products. The measure overcame fierce opposition from business lobbying groups including the US Chamber of Commerce and major retailers, over concerns Trump would leverage the legislation to expand tariffs. The Kremlin on Thursday called congressional passage an “unfriendly” move and warned it could affect negotiations to end the war. “The introduction of some additional sanctions from the US will certainly complicate efforts to reach a peaceful settlement in Ukraine,” spokesman Dmitry Peskov said, according to the Interfax news service.  The legislation opened a rift in the Democratic party, pitting Ukraine’s most ardent supporters against those more focused on tariff-spiked inflation in the run-up to a November midterm election focused heavily on voter dissatisfaction with the US economy. The vast majority of House Democrats including the party leadership voted against the bill even though it was supported by Senate Democratic leaders.  Ultimately, 58 Democrats voted for the measure, while seven Republicans opposed it.  Ukraine President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is looking to secure a meeting with Trump on the sidelines of the United Nations General Assembly next week in New York, after a string of US official correspondence with Moscow has thrown into doubt whether the US will pressure Vladimir Putin to end the war — or keep up efforts to constrain Ukraine’s attacks on Russian energy facilities that the US has blamed for a global surge in diesel prices. Denys Sienik, Ukraine’s Chargé D’Affaires, Tuesday night at an independence day celebration in Washington, thanked pro-Ukraine lawmakers “for every vote you cast in support of Ukraine, in support of freedom.” Whether the administration will actually use the new powers to boost pressure on Iran or Russia remains unclear. The White House negotiated broad waivers in the law that give the president wide discretion not to impose penalties.  The law allows the president to impose a blanket tariff of 500 per cent on Russian goods imported to the US and an additional 100 per cent tariff on the top five energy importers and countries that import Russian crude oil or natural gas, or that facilitate sanctions evasion. The new tariff authority expires after five years. The measure also extends the Iran Sanctions Act of 1996 through 2031, preventing a potential lapse in authority. That law imposes secondary economic sanctions on non-US companies doing business with Iran and was meant to expire this year.

NEW DELHI: India’s food regulator said on Friday (Sep 18) it had found a Nestle baby food sample to be substandard and was pursuing legal action against the Swiss company in one of its biggest growth markets.
Nestle said its products are “fully compliant with all the applicable regulations” and that it will continue to work closely with the regulator, without specifically commenting on the finding of a substandard sample.
The scrutiny is the latest in a crackdown on India’s US$100 billion (S$127 billion) food industry which has included surprise factory visits and product testing.
Officials found a sample of Nestle “follow-up formula”, which is a milk product for infants, was “substandard with respect to biotin”, the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) said.

The regulator specifies a standardised reference range for biotin, more commonly known as vitamin B7, in baby food.
“A reanalysis” of the sample found it was “non-conforming” with respect to prescribed biotin requirements under Indian laws, the regulator said in a social media post.
The FSSAI did not say whether it would order a recall of the product.
NESTLE FACES LEGAL CASES Nestle, whose shares in India fell almost 3 per cent following news of the action, counts India as a key growth market.
Milk and nutrition products, including infant formulas and baby foods, were Nestle India’s biggest revenue category in the year ending March 2026, generating a third of its product sales worth US$2.4 billion.
The FSSAI said it has also filed cases over two other Nestle baby food products, NAN Excella Pro Stage 1, and Lactogen Pro 1, for making misleading claims in breach of regulations.
“Three separate adjudication cases have been filed against Nestle,” the FSSAI said.
In response to the notice, Nestle India said it has again submitted its detailed response to the authorities regarding statements appearing on the label, “which are factual in nature, and supported by scientific literature”.
The labels “were approved by the expert committee of FSSAI,” it added.

Related:

Nestle CEO apologises over instant formula recall

Nestle also fell foul of India’s food regulator in 2015, when authorities banned its popular Maggi noodles over alleged excess lead levels and labelling lapses, triggering a massive recall. Maggi later returned to shelves after fresh tests.
Debate over food safety in India has intensified since Reuters reported last month that the government opted for a weaker labelling regime after lobbying by Coca-Cola and groups backing Nestle and PepsiCo, which argued that warning labels were ineffective.
Many companies, however, have implemented such measures voluntarily in European markets.

items.title: 対ロシア制裁法が成立、トランプ氏署名　ロの貿易相手国に関税
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン １８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン １８日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は１８日、上下両院が可決した包括的な対ロシア制裁法案に署名し、同法が成立した。ホワイトハウスが発表した。ウクライナ侵攻を巡るロシアへの経済的圧力を強める道が開かれた。

同法はロシアのエネルギー・防衛産業に加え、既存の制裁を回避するために使われている石油タンカーの「影の船団」を標的とし、同国の戦費を支える資金源を断つ狙いがある。

ロシアの主要な貿易相手国にも関税を課す内容となっており、将来的にトランプ氏の標的となる可能性のある他の国々にも問題を引き起こしかねないとの批判も出ている。トランプ氏の任期をはるかに超えて継続する可能性のある関税を課す権限を大統領に与えているためだ。

法案は上院が８月に、下院が今月１６日に、それぞれ可決していた。

ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は１９日未明、米議会が法案を支持・可決し、トランプ氏が署名したことに謝意を示した。

items.title: Davis Cup roundup: Ben Shelton falls, leaves U.S. tied with Czechs
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Ben Shelton, back in action after reaching the U.S. Open final last week, lost his Davis Cup match Friday as the U.S. team split the opening two singles matches with the Czech Republic in Prague during the opening day of second-round qualifying.
items.body:
Ben Shelton, back in action after reaching the U.S. Open final last week, lost his Davis Cup match Friday as the U.S. team split the opening two singles matches with the Czech Republic in Prague during the opening day of second-round qualifying.
Jiri Lehecka downed Shelton 6-4, 6-4 in 1 hour, 34 minutes, pulling the Czech team even. In the first singles match, the United States' Learner Tien defeated Jakub Mensik 6-2, 6-4.
The series will conclude on Saturday with three matches. The doubles match will feature the United States' Christian Harrison and Austin Krajicek opposing Adam Pavlasek and Patrik Rikl, with the reverse singles clashes to follow: Mensik vs. Shelton and Lehecka vs. Tien.
Davis Cup series are being contested worldwide this weekend to determine the seven teams that will join defending champion Italy in the final stage at Bologna, Italy, from Nov. 24-29.
In Quebec City, Canada jumped out to a 2-0 lead over France. Liam Draxl, ranked 205th in the world, upset 32nd-ranked Arthur Rinderknech 6-2, 7-5, before Felix Auger-Aliassime topped Quentin Halys 7-6 (5), 4-6, 6-3.
Austria and Belgium split a pair of matches in Vienna. The hosts grabbed a lead when Jurij Rodionov beat Gauthier Onclin 6-4, 6-1, but Zizou Bergs pulled the Belgians level with a 2-6, 6-4, 6-2 triumph over Lukas Neumayer.
South Korea established a 2-0 advantage over India in Seoul. Soonwoo Kwon rallied past Dhakshineswar Suresh 3-6, 6-3, 6-4, and Hyeon Chung overtook Sumit Nagal 2-6, 6-4, 7-5.
--Field Level Media
