items.title: ‘Will FOREVER have complete ability to do what is necessary in Greenland’ — Trump announces US-Denmark deal
items.author: Arshdeep Kaur
items.summary: The US-Denmark deal allows an increase in US military presence in Greenland, an autonomous territory of Denmark.
items.body: Donald Trump on Friday announced that the United States, Denmark, and Greenland have secured a deal allowing the US to establish a major military presence on the island while strictly prohibiting American adversaries from establishing bases there.In a Truth Social post, Trump wrote that US enemies would not be able to make sensitive investments on the island without US approval and that the agreement had no expiry date.“At my direction, we worked with representatives of Denmark and Greenland to guarantee that the United States will FOREVER have the complete ability to do what is necessary in Greenland in order to secure and defend the security of Greenland, and the United States of America,” Trump wrote.‘Dream come true’The US-Denmark deal allows an increase in US military presence in Greenland, an autonomous territory of Denmark. This deal stops well short of Trump's long-held dream of acquiring the island for the United States.The US already has near-total overflight and basing rights in Greenland under a 1951 treaty, according to a Reuters report.Pleased by the outcome of the negotiations, Trump's announcement suggested that he might not revive his territorial claims, at least in the near future.Without elaborating, he said the US would soon deploy a large military presence on the island, which already hosts one Space Force base in its remote northwest."This is a dream come true for the United States of America," Trump wrote.The agreement would strengthen security in the North Atlantic and Arctic, the news agency quoted the Danish prime minister's office as saying.In a statement, Greenland's prime minister, Jens-Frederik Nielsen, said that the agreement recognised Greenland's interests and the Arctic island's place in international cooperation. “This benefits us all,” he said.Extent of agreement unclearThe extent of agreement of the US-Denmark Greenland deal remains unclear, Reuters said, including whether any new US bases would be constructed under the agreement.It would be new if the US could build bases without the approval of Greenland or Denmark, but that “largely, it seems that Washington could have achieved a lot of these objectives through diplomacy and dialogue without straining the broader US-NATO relationship,” said Imran Bayoumi, a former Pentagon official now with the Atlantic Council think tank, according to Reuters.‘Greenland forever a part of strategic defence area’In a separate statement, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said that the deal "permanently and completely" addressed Washington's national security concerns regarding the island.“Greenland will forever be part of the strategic defence area of North America and exclude any adversary from it and the surrounding area,” he said.A State Department official told Reuters that the deal prohibits non-NATO countries from building a base in Greenland and will allow only the US and its allies to make unspecified "sensitive investments."The official said the agreement grants the US permanent access, basing and overflight rights, and would continue to apply even if Greenland becomes independent.(With Reuters inputs)

By Kanishka Singh

WASHINGTON, Sept 18 (Reuters) – The US State Department approved a potential $2.7 billion military sale to Ukraine for air defense development upgrades and related equipment and services, the department said in a congressional notification late on Friday.

• If the purchase is concluded, Ukraine would finance it using a combination of European contributions and US Foreign Military Financing (FMF) appropriated during the administration of former President Joe Biden, the State Department said in the notification.

Show Full Article

• FMF provides grant assistance that enables countries to purchase weapons and defense equipment produced in the United States.

• “The FMF will be counted as a US capital contribution to the Ukraine Reconstruction Investment Fund via a 1:1 reimbursement,” the State Department said.

• The US-Ukraine Reconstruction Investment Fund was established as part of a minerals deal signed between the US and Ukraine last year.

• The package includes S-300 clone missiles, GAM-67 missiles, range-extended air defense laser-guided rocket missile systems, launcher and mobile launching system modification kits and counter-drone system radars, among other weapons systems, the State Department said.

• The proposed sale is still subject to congressional review.

• President Donald Trump had said he would end Russia’s war in Ukraine when he took office early last year but the goal remains elusive 20 months into his presidency. Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in early 2022.

• Earlier on Friday, Trump signed a sweeping Russia sanctions bill into law, paving the way for increased economic pressure on Russia.

• Earlier this month, Trump said he would ask European nations to pay back the United States for military aid and munitions previously sent to Ukraine.

(Reporting by Kanishka Singh in Washington; Editing by William Mallard and Tom Hogue)

items.title: Roman Anthony sparks offense as Red Sox stop Rays' streak
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Roman Anthony homered and had three RBIs, Jahmai Jones went deep and the Boston Red Sox cooled off the first-place Tampa Bay Rays with a 4-2 victory on Friday night in St. Petersburg, Fla.
items.body:
Roman Anthony homered and had three RBIs, Jahmai Jones went deep and the Boston Red Sox cooled off the first-place Tampa Bay Rays with a 4-2 victory on Friday night in St. Petersburg, Fla.
The Red Sox (84-70) opened their final road series of the regular season by scoring all of their runs in the first three innings to win for the second consecutive night.
Anthony went 2-for-5, while Caleb Durbin was 2-for-3 as the team produced nine hits.
Starting pitcher Ranger Suarez (8-4) fought control issues but went 5 2/3 innings in earning the win. He allowed one run on three hits while striking out five and walking five.
Junior Caminero doubled, walked twice and drove in a run for Tampa Bay (93-60), but the American League's top club had only five hits, was a brutal 0-for-13 with runners in scoring position and had its six-game winning streak snapped.
Starter Ian Seymour (9-7) was hit hard in the first two innings and finished by allowing four runs on seven hits in five frames. He whiffed five and walked two.
On the third pitch of the game, leadoff hitter Anthony crushed a Statcast-estimated 438-foot blast to center field. It was the left fielder's fifth homer.
Caminero's RBI groundout tied it in the bottom half, but Anthony did more damage by ripping a two-out single to right for a 3-1 lead in the second.
Jones made it 4-1 leading off the third by lining Seymour's changeup out to left for his sixth homer.
Suarez got out of a slight jam in the third after Caminero walked and Ryan Vilade singled, but he retired red-hot Chandler Simpson and Jonny DeLuca to maintain the three-run lead.
The home club put together a strong threat in the sixth after Wyatt Olds relieved Suarez and issued two walks to fill the bases with two outs. However, he battled back in the count against pinch hitter Jake Fraley and struck him out.
In the ninth, Jonathan Aranda's groundout scored a run, but Erik Miller got Simpson to ground out to second with the bases loaded for his fifth save.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Juan Soto, Mets stop 5-game slide with win over Phillies
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Zac Thornton tossed six solid innings, Juan Soto homered among his three hits and the host New York Mets beat the Philadelphia Phillies 6-3 in the second game of a four-game series Friday.
items.body:
Zac Thornton tossed six solid innings, Juan Soto homered among his three hits and the host New York Mets beat the Philadelphia Phillies 6-3 in the second game of a four-game series Friday.
Carson Benge laced an RBI single in the first inning to give the Mets (70-84) a lead they'd never relinquish.
Fellow rookie outfielder A.J. Ewing added a two-run single two batters later, and Soto delivered a three-run homer in the sixth as New York snapped a five-game losing streak -- its longest since a seven-game slide from June 20-26.
Soto was 3-for-5 and Benge and Francisco Lindor finished with two hits for the Mets, who received one hit apiece from their other six starters.
Thornton (5-5) gave up two runs on five hits and one walk while striking out four over six innings. He is 5-4 with a 3.26 ERA in 12 starts since his most recent promotion from Triple-A Syracuse.
Bryson Stott delivered a run-scoring double in the second before Edmundo Sosa and Derek Hill hit solo homers in the sixth and seventh for the Phillies, who missed a chance to snap a tie with the Chicago Cubs for the top wild-card spot in the National League. The Cubs suffered a 6-4 loss to the Cincinnati Reds.
Sosa finished 3-for-3 as Philadelphia fell to 7-9 this month.
Nate Lavender surrendered Hill's homer in 1 2/3 innings before Dedniel Nunez recorded his first save by tossing 1 1/3 perfect innings.
Tim Mayza (3-4), serving in an opener role, took the loss for the Phillies after allowing three runs on three hits and one walk in one-third of an inning. Mayza tossed 32 pitches and had back-to-back 10-pitch battles with Soto and Bo Bichette, the second and third batters he faced.
Jose Urquidy relieved Mayza and allowed five hits over 4 2/3 scoreless innings. Urquidy, who was claimed off waivers from the Chicago White Sox on Thursday, walked none while striking out six.
--Field Level Media

WASHINGTON: US President Donald Trump plans to greet Chinese President Xi Jinping at Joint Base Andrews, at the airport of the military base just outside Washington, DC, on his arrival next week for a White House visit, a senior US official told reporters on Friday (Sep 18).
It is rare for the US president to greet visiting foreign leaders at the airport.
Senior US officials who briefed reporters about the visit said it will include an arrival ceremony inside the White House, a Rose Garden military review and a state dinner in the evening.
They said among the guests for the dinner will be a number of tech CEOs, including Jeff Bezos of Amazon, Sundar Pichai of Alphabet, Sam Altman of OpenAI, Tim Cook of Apple, Elon Musk of Tesla, Jensen Huang of Nvidia, and Michael Dell of Dell Technologies.

“Thousands of people would love to be at that dinner,” Trump told reporters during Friday's briefing in the Oval Office.
"I've told a lot of very good friends of mine, 'you just can’t come'," Trump added.
Issues such as trade, flow of rare earths to the global economy and AI are expected to be among the topics that will be discussed during the visit, officials said.

Screenshot taken from a video shared by US first lady Melania Trump on X - showing a welcome invitation bearing the names of Chinese President Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan. (Credit: @FLOTUS/X)

First ladies Melania Trump and Peng Liyuan will also hold a separate engagement, US officials said during Friday's briefing.
Xi and Peng will be the guests of honour at a formal state dinner for the Chinese delegation on Sep 24, that will be hosted by the Trumps.

items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米グーグルのAIモデル「Gemini（ジェミニ）」が5月、サイバーセキュリティー試験中に意図せず3社のシステムに侵入した。AIエージェントによる一連のシステム侵入を受け、セキュリティー専門家やAI開発者の間で懸念が高まっている。

侵入は、AIセキュリティー企業イレギュラーが実施した同じ試験中に起きた。この試験では、OpenAI、アンソロピック、メタ・プラットフォームズでも侵入が発生し、既に公表されている。イレギュラーは18日、一連の侵入が全て同じ問題に関連していたことを確認し、7月下旬に関係するAI開発者へ通知したことを明らかにした。

グーグルが確認した侵入事例の1つは、Geminiに架空の企業から情報を取得するよう指示した際に起きた。その架空企業は偶然、実在する企業と同じ名前だった。米紙ウォールストリート・ジャーナル（WSJ）が先に報じた後、グーグルが確認した。Geminiはパスワードを推測し、実在企業のサービスにアクセスした。グーグルの広報担当者によると、同社は当局に通知した。

AIエージェント型システムによる最近の一連の侵入を受け、AIのリスク増大や、リスク軽減に必要な措置を巡り世界的な議論が巻き起こっている。アンソロピックのダリオ・アモデイ最高経営責任者（CEO）は、業界全体でAI技術の開発ペースを落とすよう呼びかけている。この提案にはOpenAIのサム・アルトマンCEOやイーロン・マスク氏らが賛同している。

一方、トランプ米大統領、エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアンCEO、メタのマーク・ザッカーバーグCEOらは、自主規制が可能なはずだとして新たな規制の導入に反対している。AI分野の一部新興企業も、規制強化によって小規模企業が大手と競争することが難しくなる恐れがあると主張している。

グーグルのセキュリティーエンジニアリング担当バイスプレジデント、ヘザー・アドキンス氏は、Geminiによる一連の侵入について「強力なAIモデルが責任ある行動を取るよう訓練することの重要性を浮き彫りにしている」と述べた。

items.title: LSU QB Sam Leavitt off availability report for Ole Miss showdown
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Sam Leavitt injury saga took another turn Friday night when the LSU quarterback was removed from the Southeastern Conference's availability report -- just two days after he was deemed doubtful to play.
items.body:
The Sam Leavitt injury saga took another turn Friday night when the LSU quarterback was removed from the Southeastern Conference's availability report -- just two days after he was deemed doubtful to play.
LSU upgraded Leavitt from doubtful to questionable Thursday and then took him off the report entirely Friday in time for the No. 7 Tigers' rivalry showdown Saturday against No. 8 Ole Miss in Oxford, Miss.
Per the SEC's availability policy, a player designated as doubtful has a 25% chance to play and is "unlikely to play due to significant concerns," while questionable is meant to describe a 50% chance of playing.
The nature of Leavitt's injury or when it occurred remains a mystery, with conflicting reports emerging that he had either back spasms or a sore throwing shoulder.
ESPN reported Friday that Ole Miss staff do not feel LSU was "sincere" in choosing to list Leavitt -- indicating it could be gamesmanship from Tigers coach Lane Kiffin before he goes up against his most recent program.
Kiffin and the Tigers could be in hot water with the league if they were found to be fibbing about Leavitt's health. The SEC policy for football states that the penalty for the first offense regarding an inaccurate or late report is $25,000. It is at the discretion of SEC commissioner Greg Sankey whether to impose a penalty.
At a Monday news conference, LSU coach Lane Kiffin did not say anything about Leavitt's health. He also didn't speak on the matter during his weekly radio show on Thursday night.
In two games with LSU, Leavitt has completed 41 of 66 passes for 574 yards, two touchdowns and four interceptions. The Arizona State transfer has also rushed for 135 yards and five scores.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Spencer Horwitz, Konnor Griffin power Pirates past Royals
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Konnor Griffin had four hits and two RBIs, and Spencer Horwitz delivered a tiebreaking two-run single in the seventh as the Pittsburgh Pirates rallied to win 8-5 over the visiting Kansas City Royals on Friday night.
items.body:
Konnor Griffin had four hits and two RBIs, and Spencer Horwitz delivered a tiebreaking two-run single in the seventh as the Pittsburgh Pirates rallied to win 8-5 over the visiting Kansas City Royals on Friday night.
Pittsburgh (77-77) trailed 4-0 after the top of the third inning and 5-2 entering the bottom of the fourth but fought back to take the lead in the seventh.
With the scored tied 5-5 and Kansas City's Nate Pearson (2-2) pitching, Oneil Cruz reached on an infield single and Nick Gonzales was hit by a pitch. Both advanced on a wild pitch and eventually scored on Horwitz's second hit of the night. Griffin added an RBI single later in the frame, helping the Pirates win their second straight after losing four of their last five.
Vinnie Pasquantino and Michael Massey each homered as Kansas City (67-87) scored five runs against Pittsburgh ace Paul Skenes, who scattered six hits and struck out seven in his six innings. After Skenes' exit, the Royals managed just two total hits against relievers Brandon Eisert, Yohan Ramirez (7-4) and Gregory Soto to fall to 5-12 since Aug. 30.
Kansas City wasted no time getting to Skenes as Pasquantino lined a two-out solo homer over the right field wall in the first inning. Then with two outs in the third, Pasquantino lined a run-scoring single to right and Maikel Garcia followed with a two-run double.
The Pirates got to Royals starter Randy Dobnak in the bottom of the third. After Griffin singled, Brandon Lowe went deep over the right-center-field wall to make it 4-2.
Kansas City got a run back in the fourth when Massey turned on a Skenes pitch that landed in the right field seats. Pittsburgh answered in the bottom of that frame with Henry Davis' RBI double to right and Griffin's run-scoring groundout.
Dobnak allowed four runs on seven hits and two walks over 3 2/3 innings.
Pittsburgh tied it in the fifth when Cruz doubled, went to third on Gonzales' single and scored on a fielder's choice off the bat of Ryan O'Hearn.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Eugenio Suarez, Jose Trevino fuel Reds’ comeback win over Cubs
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: The Cincinnati Reds scored three times in the sixth inning in a back-and-forth 6-4 win over the visiting Chicago Cubs on Friday.
items.body:
The Cincinnati Reds scored three times in the sixth inning in a back-and-forth 6-4 win over the visiting Chicago Cubs on Friday.
Starting pitcher Chase Burns allowed two runs on four hits and struck out four in three innings for the Reds (72-82).
Cubs starter Clay Holmes (6-8) surrendered six runs on three hits, fanning four while walking five, in 5 1/3 innings.
Down by one entering its half of the sixth, Cincinnati went ahead 6-4.
Elly De La Cruz drew a leadoff walk and reached third when Holmes' pickoff attempt missed first baseman Michael Busch.
Holmes walked Tyler Stephenson and JJ Bleday in consecutive plate appearances, loading the bases. That ended Holmes' outing, and Javier Assad replaced him.
Eugenio Suarez singled to left field to score De La Cruz and tie it 4-4. Jose Trevino later drove in Bleday and Suarez with a single that put the hosts up by two.
The Reds opened the scoring in the bottom of the first inning. Carlos Jorge tripled to center field to open the frame, and De La Cruz walked. With Sal Stewart at the plate, De La Cruz stole second, and then Jorge scored on Stewart's sacrifice fly that saw De La Cruz tag up and go to third.
Stephenson drove in De La Cruz with a single up the middle that hopped off the glove of second baseman Nico Hoerner into center field to make it 2-0.
The Cubs (85-69) cut it to 2-1 in the top of the second. Hoerner and Michael Conforto each singled to the outfield, with Hoerner advancing to third on Conforto's hit. Carson Kelly brought Hoerner home with another single.
Ian Happ tied it 2-2 in the third with a two-out home run to right-center.
Cincinnati went ahead 3-2 in the bottom half. Jorge walked, advanced to third on a De La Cruz single, and scored when Stewart grounded into a double play.
Chicago took its first lead in the fourth against reliever Julian Aguiar (1-0). Kelly walked, went to second when Dansby Swanson reached on a forceout. Each advanced on Pete Crow-Armstrong's flyout to center and scored on Seiya Suzuki's single for a 4-3 advantage.
--Field Level Media

items.title: ゴルフ＝ビルトモア選手権、金谷が予選通過　平田らは予選落ち
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１８日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１８日　ロイター］ - 米男子ゴルフの秋季シリーズ、ビルトモア選手権は１８日、ノースカロライナ州アッシュビルのクリフ・ウォルナットコーブ（パー７１）で第２ラウンドを行い、前日１１２位の金谷拓実が６１位に浮上して予選を通過した。

金谷は４バーディー、１イーグル、１ボギーの６６をマークし、スコアを５つ伸ばして通算３アンダーの１３９をマークした。

前日５３位の中島啓太は７１にとどまり、通算２アンダーの１４０で７７位。カットラインに１打届かず予選落ちした。

同じく前日５３位の久常涼は７３で回り、通算イーブンパーの１４２で９４位となり、決勝ラウンド進出を逃した。

日本勢最上位の３２位で初日を終えていた平田憲聖は、１バーディー、７ボギー、１ダブルボギーと崩れて７９。通算５オーバーの１４７で１１８位となり、同じく予選落ちした。

首位には前日３位のニール・シプリー（米国）が浮上した。１イーグル、７バーディー、ノーボギーの９アンダーの６２で、通算１５アンダーの１２７とした。ベン・コールズ（米国）が１打差で２位。

items.title: テニス＝世界1位ルバキナ、ＢＪＫ杯決勝大会を欠場　過密日程で回復優先
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１８日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１８日　ロイター］ - 女子テニスで世界ランキング１位に浮上したエレーナ・ルバキナ（２７、カザフスタン）は１８日、身体的に負荷のかかった１カ月を過ごしたとして、２２日に中国の深センで開幕する国別対抗戦ビリー・ジーン・キング（ＢＪＫ）杯決勝大会を欠場することを明らかにした。

ルバキナは先週末の全米オープン決勝で、大会３連覇を狙ったベラルーシ出身のアリーナ・サバレンカを下して優勝。世界ランキング１位の座も手にした。

大会前には足首の負傷で出場が危ぶまれていたが、それを乗り越え、今年の全豪オープンに続く四大大会制覇。２０２２年のウィンブルドン選手権と合わせ、四大大会のタイトルは３個となった。

ルバキナはインスタグラムに「今年のＢＪＫ杯には出場できないことを発表しなければならない。素晴らしい観客がいるすてきな場所、深センに行けないのはとても悲しい」と投稿。「この１カ月は体にとって厳しいものだった。回復し、再び最高の状態で戦えるようにする必要がある。みんなの幸運を祈っている」とした。

ＢＪＫ杯決勝大会は２２日から２７日にかけて開催され、カザフスタンは２３日の準々決勝でスペインと対戦する。イタリアが大会２連覇中。

items.title: サッカー＝フランス代表のジダン監督、初陣にジャケら5選手初招集
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［パリ　１８日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［パリ　１８日　ロイター］ - サッカーのフランス代表を率いるジネディーヌ・ジダン新監督（５４）は１８日、欧州ネーションズリーグ４試合に臨む代表メンバー２３人を発表し、リバプール（イングランド）所属のＤＦジェレミー・ジャケなど５選手を初招集した。

今夏のワールドカップ（Ｗ杯）北中米３カ国大会をベスト４で終えたフランスは、大会後にディディエ・デシャン監督が退任。レアル・マドリード（スペイン）を欧州チャンピオンズリーグ（ＣＬ）３連覇に導いた実績を持つジダン監督が２０３０年Ｗ杯までの任期で指揮官に就任した。

ジダン監督はジャケのほか、ＧＫギヨーム・レステ、ＤＦアンディ・ディウフ、ＭＦルーカス・ダ・クーニャ、ＦＷエステバン・ルポールを初招集。負傷明けのＭＦオーレリアン・チュアメニやＦＷマルクス・テュラムらがメンバーから外れた。キャプテンは引き続きレアル・マドリード所属のＦＷキリアン・エムバペが務める。

ジダン監督は記者会見で、「私は常にフランス代表を追いかけてきた。このチームには強い愛着がある。自分に課せられた任務は理解している」と述べた。

ジダン監督の初陣は２５日にアウェーで行われるトルコ戦となる。フランスはその後、２８日に敵地でベルギーと対戦。１０月２日にイタリア、同５日にベルギーをいずれもホームに迎える。

items.title: サッカー＝バルセロナのヤマルが人種差別の経験語る、「1000回はある」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１８日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１８日　ロイター］ - サッカーのスペイン１部バルセロナに所属するＦＷラミン・ヤマル（１９）は、これまでに「１０００回」もの人種差別を経験してきたと語った。その際、多くの人が自身の発言や行動が人種差別にあたると自覚していないと指摘している。

スペイン人種差別・外国人排斥監視機関は３月に発表した報告書の中で、２０２５年第４四半期にスペイン国内でオンライン上の人種差別的な誹謗中傷の標的となった頻度が最も高かったのは、ヤマルとレアル・マドリードのビニシウス・ジュニオールだったとした。２４年１０月には、レアル・マドリードとバルセロナの試合中、ヤマルとラフィーニャ、アンス・ファティが人種差別的な誹謗中傷を受けているとみられる様子を捉えた映像が公開されていた。

スペインの放送局モビスターのインタビューで、元アルゼンチン代表のホルヘ・バルダーノ氏から直接的な人種差別を経験したことがあるか尋ねられたヤマルは「１０００回はある」と口にし、「人々は間接的に人種差別的な態度をとることがあるが、おそらく本人たちはそれに気づいていない。人種差別的な発言や視線はたくさんあるが、彼らはそれに気づきもしない」と述べた。

また、「誰かに『黒人』と呼ばれても全く気にならない。結局のところ私は黒人であり、他の肌の色ではないからだ。問題はそれが良いことか悪いことか、あるいは私を傷つけるつもりで言っているのかどうかだ。でも、彼らが私を見るためにチケット代を払ってくれているのなら、試合中にただ失礼な態度をとられたからといって怒るようなことはない」と語った。

スペインサッカー界では近年、注目を集める人種差別事件が相次いでおり、ラ・リーガはスタジアム内での人種差別的な暴言を根絶するための取り組みを強化している。

items.title: サッカー＝チェルシー、ブレントフォードに完敗　開幕5戦12失点
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ロンドン　１８日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ロンドン　１８日　ロイター］ - サッカーのイングランド・プレミアリーグは１８日、１試合を行い、チェルシーは敵地でブレントフォードに０─３で完敗した。

前半をスコアレスで折り返したチェルシーは、後半１６分に先制点を許すと、同３８分にも失点。試合終了間際にもゴールを決められた。

開幕２試合でフラム、ブライトンに連勝したものの、その後はアーセナルに１─２で敗れ、ハルとは２─２で引き分け。この日の敗戦で開幕５試合の失点は１２に膨らんだ。一方、ブレントフォードは開幕から５試合無敗。

チェルシーのシャビアロンソ監督は記者団に対し、「９５分間を通じて（高い）レベルを維持することが重要だ。開幕からの数試合ではそれができておらず、改善しなければならない」とコメント。「まだ５試合で、これはプロセスの途中。プレミアリーグは競争が激しく、どの試合も非常に難しい」と語った。

SEOUL: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un’s powerful sister, Kim Yo Jong , accused the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) of double standards on Saturday (Sep 19) after it adopted a resolution criticising Pyongyang’s nuclear weapons programme.
The IAEA’s “biased viewpoint and double standards” are “the fundamental factor causing the collapse of the international nuclear non-proliferation system”, Kim Yo Jong said in a statement carried by the state-run Korean Central News Agency (KCNA).
She said the agency had turned a blind eye to the “blatant nuclear proliferation activities” of the United States and South Korea’s “nuclear submarine introduction plan”, while forcibly adopting a resolution against North Korea’s “self-defensive and legitimate nuclear activities”.
In a separate KCNA statement, North Korea’s Foreign Ministry also dismissed the resolution, declaring that its status as a nuclear power is irreversible and backed by its nuclear deterrent.

items.body:
Authorities resumed flight operations at Luxembourg Airport on Saturday after suspending services the previous evening following the detection of "unauthorized unmanned aircraft systems", or drones, near and over the aerodrome.
The airport, Luxembourg's sole international airport, said it imposed the suspension on Friday as a precautionary measure to ensure the safety of passengers, airline crews, airport personnel and aircraft.
The airport did not provide details on the origin of the drones or say who was operating them.
While flights have resumed, some delays and disruptions could persist as airlines and airport partners work to restore normal schedules, the airport said in a notice.
Luxembourg Airport, the main hub for the country's flag carrier Luxair, said it was continuing to monitor the situation in coordination with relevant authorities.

SYDNEY, Sept 19 (Reuters) – Several beaches along the coast of Western Australia, including in the state capital Perth, remained closed on Saturday, a day after a fatal shark attack at a popular beach in the city.

The victim, a male swimmer, died on Friday after being mauled at Sorrento Beach, around 20 km (12 miles) from Perth’s central business district, prompting the closure of beaches along 30 km (20 miles) of coastline.

The local council said in a Facebook post that beaches would remain closed until at least noon (0400 GMT) on Saturday.

Show Full Article

Friday’s incident is the latest in a series of shark attacks in Australia and comes after a surfer was bitten in an attack in the same state on Monday.

In that attack, a surfer was bitten at a beach in the town of Geraldton, around 400 km (250 miles) north of Perth. The surfer lost his foot in the attack and suffered serious leg injuries, local media said.

In June a 35-year-old man was killed while spearfishing off the state’s south coast, while a 38-year-old man was mauled to death off an island near Perth in May.

items.title: Poutine accuse l'Ukraine d'ingérence dans les élections législatives russes
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Le président russe Vladimir Poutine a déclaré vendredi que l'Ukraine entravait délibérément les négociations visant à mettre fin à la guerre et a accusé Kyiv de s'ingérer dans les élections législatives russes.
items.body:
Le président russe Vladimir Poutine a déclaré vendredi que l'Ukraine entravait délibérément les négociations visant à mettre fin à la guerre et a accusé Kyiv de s'ingérer dans les élections législatives russes.
Vladimir Poutine a également réaffirmé devant la commission militaro-industrielle que le principal objectif de Moscou en matière de défense était de s'appuyer sur sa "triade nucléaire" et a déclaré que la Russie devait également s'attacher à améliorer ses défenses antimissiles.
Le chef du Kremlin a déclaré que les frappes ukrainiennes sur des cibles russes montraient que les propositions de Kyiv visant à mener des négociations pour mettre fin à la guerre étaient de mauvaise foi.
Vladimir Poutine a déclaré qu'une frappe ukrainienne avait récemment touché une maison dans un village situé dans une zone de Zaporijjia occupée par la Russie, tuant le président de la commission électorale locale.
"En commettant ce genre de crimes, ils font tout pour s'assurer qu'il n'y ait ni paix ni négociations", a-t-il estimé, selon des propos rapportés par les agences de presse russes.
Vladimir Poutine a déclaré que l'Ukraine avait "depuis longtemps sombré dans la dictature", faisant référence au fait que le pays n'avait pas organisé de nouvelle élection présidentielle malgré l'expiration du mandat du président Volodimir Zelensky.
"Comme vous le savez, les dirigeants ukrainiens ne sont pas pressés d'organiser des élections, mais ils tentent également de s'ingérer dans nos affaires", a déclaré le président russe.
Volodimir Zelensky et d'autres responsables ukrainiens affirment qu'aucune élection ne peut avoir lieu dans leur pays tant que l'état d'urgence, déclaré au début de l'invasion russe de février 2022, reste en vigueur.
Kyiv qualifie les élections législatives russes de "pseudo-élections" dont le résultat ne fait aucun doute.
Le vote pour les premières [USN:L8N45A0W2 TEXT:"élections législatives"] organisées en Russie depuis l'invasion de l'Ukraine, un scrutin de trois jours que le président Vladimir Poutine présente comme un baromètre du soutien à la guerre contre l'Ukraine, a débuté vendredi.

items.title: Saudi civil defence sends all-clear after alerts issued for capital Riyadh
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Saudi civil defence sent an all-clear on Saturday after issuing alerts for a second time for potential danger in Riyadh and the city of Al-Kharj east of the capital, amid an uptick in attacks by Iran-aligned Houthis on the Gulf country.
items.body:
Saudi civil defence sent an all-clear on Saturday after issuing alerts for a second time for potential danger in Riyadh and the city of Al-Kharj east of the capital, amid an uptick in attacks by Iran-aligned Houthis on the Gulf country.
The alerts were the first for the capital since Houthis in neighbouring Yemen intensified their attacks on Saudi Arabia.
A Reuters journalist heard two booms in Riyadh’s Olaya area.
The alerts come hours after the Houthis' military spokesperson said the group had foiled unspecified "criminal attempts" in the Yemeni capital Sanaa, blaming Saudi Arabia and vowing a response.
There was no immediate comment from the Saudi government's media office on the Houthis' statement.
The Houthis, who control the most populous parts of Yemen and much of the north, have been [USN:L4N45908T TEXT:"launching attacks"] towards Saudi Arabia since declaring a naval [USN:L1N43M00A TEXT:"blockade against Riyadh"] in July, with strikes targeting Saudi vessels in the Red Sea.
The Iran-aligned group, which seized Yemen's entire Red Sea coast in a [USN:L6N4580DE TEXT:"lightning advance"] this month, says the Saudi Air Force has conducted hundreds of airstrikes in recent days.
The UN Security Council in a statement on Friday "condemned in the strongest terms continued Houthi attacks against the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, including attacks impacting civilian and energy infrastructure, which have resulted in the injury of civilians, including women and children."
In the statement, the Security Council also condemned "Houthi military escalation in Yemen".

items.title: トランプ氏、CNNやポリティコなどをホワイトハウスから締め出しへ
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）： トランプ米大統領は18日、ケーブルニュース局CNNとMS
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： トランプ米大統領は18日、ケーブルニュース局CNNとMS NOW、オンラインメディアのポリティコをホワイトハウスから締め出す方針を示した。合衆国憲法修正第1条が保障する報道の自由の根幹に関わる措置となる。

トランプ氏はこの日、SNSへの投稿で、政権に不利な報道を行っているとして、取材禁止措置を「即時適用」すると表明。「他のフェイクニュース・メディアも後に続く」と述べ、他の報道機関も締め出す構えをみせた。

18日午後に大統領執務室で記者から、なぜ今になって締め出しを決めたのかと問われたトランプ氏は、「ここ数年の報道の積み重ねということだ。うんざりする」と答えた。ニューヨーク・タイムズとワシントン・ポストも自身が「フェイクニュース」とみなす例として挙げ、「おそらく今後、ホワイトハウスに新聞を置くこともなくなるだろう」と述べた。

大統領が禁止措置をどう実施するのかは、すぐには明らかになっていない。

トランプ氏は措置の内容について問われ、「非常に単純な禁止措置だ。彼らには私の執務室に入ってほしくない。ここにもいてほしくない。可能な限り広範な禁止措置になると言えるだろう」と語った。

この措置が実施されれば、法廷で争われる可能性が高い。連邦裁判所はこれまでにも、記者をホワイトハウスの敷地から全面的に締め出そうとしたトランプ政権の措置を覆している。

トランプ氏は、禁止措置が裁判官によって無効とされる可能性があることを認め、「この措置が存続するかどうかにかかわらず、指摘するのは良いことだと思う」と述べた。

合衆国憲法修正第1条は、言論や報道の自由を制限する法律を政府が制定することを禁じている。

CNNは声明で「CNNはホワイトハウス取材チームと、その公正かつ正確な報道を全面的に支持する。われわれには、政府による妨害や干渉を受けることなく報道する権利が合衆国憲法によって認められている。トランプ大統領が警告した禁止措置が実施されれば、基本的かつ憲法で保障された権利に対する違法な侵害となる」と表明した。

items.title: Padre de estudiante española muerta en México llega al país, tras detención de sospechoso
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El padre de una estudiante española de intercambio, que murió de forma violenta en México, llegó el viernes al estado mexicano Morelos para identificar el cuerpo de su hija, un día después de que las autoridades detuvieran a un sospechoso de su asesinato.
items.body:
El padre de una estudiante española de intercambio, que murió de forma violenta en México, llegó el viernes al estado mexicano Morelos para identificar el cuerpo de su hija, un día después de que las autoridades detuvieran a un sospechoso de su asesinato.
Claudia Tacoronte, de 21 años, murió a causa de las múltiples puñaladas que recibió el 12 de septiembre en la ciudad Cuautla, luego de un supuesto intento de robo de teléfono celular, informaron autoridades mexicanas.
El jueves por la noche, autoridades anunciaron que habían arrestado a un sospechoso, identificado como Francisco Javier "N."
El caso ha provocado una gran indignación tanto en México como en España, y los estudiantes exigen mayor protección para las mujeres. México lleva mucho tiempo lidiando con altos niveles de violencia de género, incluyendo los feminicidios.
El diario español El País, citando a fuentes cercanas a la investigación, informó que el sospechoso había confesado el crimen contra la joven. El fiscal estatal de Morelos, Fernando Blumenkron, declaró que el caso está siendo tratado como un feminicidio, es decir, una muerte motivada por razones de género.
Según datos oficiales, Morelos registró 21 feminicidios entre enero y julio de este año, mientras que en todo México ocurrieron 380 casos durante el mismo periodo.
El sospechoso debía comparecer ante un juez el viernes por la tarde. El fiscal estatal sostuvo que su oficina solicitaría la pena máxima en prisión de 70 años.
Blumenkron explicó a periodistas que el sospechoso atacó a Tacoronte a las afueras de un edificio cultural donde ella asistía a una conferencia y se hospedaba, y agregó que Francisco Javier "N" tenía antecedentes penales por robo e incluso ya había estado en prisión.
Tacoronte era una estudiante de la Universidad de Granada, en España, y había llegado a mediados de agosto a México como parte de un programa de intercambio de la Universidad Autónoma del Estado de Morelos.
Según estudiantiles, al menos cuatro jóvenes de la misma universidad han sido asesinadas en lo que va de 2026. Tras los hechos, el Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores de España instó a sus ciudadanos evitar viajes no esenciales a Morelos, citando el aumento de la violencia relacionada con el narcotráfico y los secuestros.
La Universidad de Granada también ha cancelado las prácticas de intercambio de tres estudiantes más que iban a participar en el mismo programa en octubre.

items.title: Brooks takes three-peat at Trestles Pro; Pupo claims men's win for Brazil
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Canadian teenage surfing phenomenon Erin Brooks claimed her third straight world championship tour event on Friday with a win at the Trestles Pro, while Brazil's Miguel Pupo took out Japan's Kanoa Igarashi for his second win of the year.
items.body:
Canadian teenage surfing phenomenon Erin Brooks claimed her third straight world championship tour event on Friday with a win at the Trestles Pro, while Brazil's Miguel Pupo took out Japan's Kanoa Igarashi for his second win of the year.
Identified early as a potential world champion, the 19-year-old Brooks struggled in the first six events of her sophomore season, failing to make it out of the second round. But a spectacular performance saw her claim a win in the [USN:L6N44A0ET TEXT:"heaving barrels of Tahiti"], and she backed it up at another powerful South Pacific reef break to triumph at [USN:L4N44V05O TEXT:"the Fiji Pro"] just a couple of weeks later.
Lower Trestles, the surfing venue[USN:L1N3QT12B TEXT:" for the 2028 LA Olympics"], is a very different kind of wave but one of the best in the sport's commercial homeland of Southern California and the cobblestone peak delivered high-performance, head-high waves for the finals.
After taking out five-times world champion Carissa Moore in their quarterfinal and Australia's reigning world champion Molly Picklum in the semifinal, Brooks got off to a strong start in the final against world No. 1 Gabriela Bryan, scoring 7.0 out of 10 for a series of sharp, accurate turns on her backhand.
Bryan keep herself in the contest with a 6.33 with some trademark powerful gouges on her forehand and backed it up with a 5.57 for a 11.90 total. But Brooks looked in control throughout, holding the lead after a second mid-range score and sealing the deal with another well-surfed right-hander as the clock wound down for a 6.0 and a 13-point total.
"The first part of the year was such a bummer, but this makes it worth it. So many hard heats just made me want to work even harder and now I've gotten to this point and I want to keep going," Brooks said after her win. "Last year, I went surfing (here) right after the girl's final and I could hear from the water them giving the trophies to someone else and I said to myself 'Next year, I want to do that for myself.'"
Brooks' three-peat was the first on the world tour since Australia's eight-time world champion Stephanie Gilmore did it in 2008.
Igarashi's parents moved to Southern California from Japan just before he was born, hoping he could become a professional surfer. The 28-year-old, who won silver for Japan at the Tokyo Olympics, took at early advantage in the final with a couple of mid-range scores with some powerful turns on his forehand on the crumbling walls and kept improving his scoreline, notching up a 7.67 and then a 6.73 to open up 14.40 total and a solid advantage.
But Pupo got the better of one exchange, caught the bigger second wave of a set and belted it multiple times on his backhand for an excellent 8.5. He then held his nerve and waited for a long left-hander on which he mixed up sharp turns and a small aerial to score a 6.27 for a 14.77 total and the lead as the clock wound down.
"It's been such hard work this year," said the 34-year-old, who is competing in his 16th year on tour. "I feel like this is my last shot at it, and so I'm going to do it all the way and I'm happy to come up with two wins."
The tour now breaks into a two-event "post-season" with contests for the top 24 men and 16 women in Portugal and the Philippines, before the whole field returns for the season finale at Hawaii's Pipeline in December.

Bryan keep herself in the contest with a 6.33 with some trademark powerful gouges on her forehand and backed it up with a 5.57 for a 11.90 total. But Brooks looked in control throughout, holding the lead after a second mid-range score and sealing the deal with another well-surfed right-hander as the clock wound down for a 6.0 and a 13-point total.
"The first part of the year was such a bummer, but this makes it worth it. So many hard heats just made me want to work even harder and now I've gotten to this point and I want to keep going," Brooks said after her win. "Last year, I went surfing (here) right after the girl's final and I could hear from the water them giving the trophies to someone else and I said to myself 'Next year, I want to do that for myself.'"
Brooks' three-peat was the first on the world tour since Australia's eight-time world champion Stephanie Gilmore did it in 2008. 
Igarashi's parents moved to Southern California from Japan just before he was born, hoping he could become a professional surfer. The 28-year-old, who won silver for Japan at the Tokyo Olympics, took at early advantage in the final with a couple of mid-range scores with some powerful turns on his forehand on the crumbling walls and kept improving his scoreline, notching up a 7.67 and then a 6.73 to open up 14.40 total and a solid advantage.
But Pupo got the better of one exchange, caught the bigger second wave of a set and belted it multiple times on his backhand for an excellent 8.5. He then held his nerve and waited for a long left-hander on which he mixed up sharp turns and a small aerial to score a 6.27 for a 14.77 total and the lead as the clock wound down.
"It's been such hard work this year," said the 34-year-old, who is competing in his 16th year on tour. "I feel like this is my last shot at it, and so I'm going to do it all the way and I'm happy to come up with two wins."
The tour now breaks into a two-event "post-season" with contests for the top 24 men and 16 women in Portugal and the Philippines, before the whole field returns for the season finale at Hawaii's Pipeline in December.

items.title: サッカー＝バイエルンが7発大勝、ケーンが記録更新　伊藤出番なし
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ミュンヘン（ドイツ）　１８日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ミュンヘン（ドイツ）　１８日　ロイター］ - サッカーのドイツ１部ブンデスリーガは１８日、１試合を行い、伊藤洋輝が所属するバイエルン・ミュンヘンはホームでウニオン・ベルリンに７─０で大勝した。

前半１８分にジャマル・ムシアラが先制点を挙げたバイエルンは、同３９分にＰＫ獲得からハリー・ケーンが追加点。ケーンはブンデスリーガ９８試合目の出場で通算１００ゴールに到達し、１９７０年代にディーター・ミュラーが１２９試合で達成した記録を大幅に塗り替える史上最速記録を樹立した。

同４３分にミカエル・オリーズがチーム３点目を挙げると、後半９分にはケーンがこの日２得点目。その後、イスマエル・サイバリがネットを揺らすと、２得点を加点したオリーズがハットトリックを達成した。伊藤はベンチスタートから出番がなかった。

バイエルンは４試合で勝ち点１０とし、暫定首位に浮上。勝ち点９で２位のフライブルクは、１９日にアイントラハト・フランクフルトとのアウェー戦を迎える。

items.title: サッカー＝ロナルド、ジェズス監督就任後初のポルトガル代表メンバーに選出
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１８日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１８日　ロイター］ - サッカーのポルトガル代表を率いるジョルジェ・ジェズス新監督は１８日、欧州ネーションズリーグ４試合に臨む代表メンバー２５人を発表し、主将のクリスティアノ・ロナルド（４１）を選出した。

ロナルドは８月、今後１年が現役生活の最後になる可能性が高いと発言し、引退時期を巡る臆測を呼んでいた。７月には今夏のワールドカップ（Ｗ杯）が自身最後のＷ杯になると明らかにした一方、代表引退については慎重な姿勢を示していた。

ポルトガルはＷ杯の決勝トーナメント２回戦で、後に優勝するスペインに敗れた。マンチェスター・ユナイテッド（イングランド）やレアル・マドリード（スペイン）、ユベントス（イタリア）などで数々のタイトルを獲得してきたロナルドだが、Ｗ杯優勝には届かなかった。

ジェズス監督は記者会見で、ロナルドについて「重要なのは彼のパフォーマンス。過去は関係ない。クリスもほかの選手と同じ。良いパフォーマンスをすればプレーするし、そうでなければプレーしない。バロンドールを５回受賞しており、特別な立場ではあるが、それが私の判断に影響することはない」と語った。

ポルトガルは２４日にホームでウェールズと対戦し、ジェズス監督の初陣を迎える。２７日に敵地でノルウェー、１０月１日に敵地でデンマークと対戦し、４日にはホームで再びノルウェーと顔を合わせる。

items.title: ＭＬＢ＝ドジャース守護神ディアスが戦線復帰
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１８日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１８日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）ドジャースは１８日、首の炎症で負傷者リスト（ＩＬ）入りしていた抑えのエドウィン・ディアス投手を戦列に復帰させた。ＭＬＢ公式サイトが伝えた。

ディアスは１６日に傘下３Ａで５度目のリハビリ登板に臨み、１回を無失点。１５球を投げて１１球がストライク、２死から二塁打を許したものの後続を抑えた。リハビリ登板５試合では４回１／３を投げて６失点、防御率１２．４６。７四球に対して４三振と制球面に課題を残した。

今季から３年６９００万ドル（約１０８億円）の契約でドジャースに加入したディアスは、４月に右肘の遊離体を除去する手術を受けると、８月には首の炎症で再びＩＬ入り。１１度のセーブ機会で４度失敗し、防御率１１．８５と苦しんでいる。

デーブ・ロバーツ監督は、復帰当初は重要度の低い場面で起用する方針を示しており、状態が上向かなければポストシーズンのロースターから外れる可能性もあるとしている。

ドジャースでは佐々木朗希投手も右手中指のまめで１５日間のＩＬ入りしている。昨季のポストシーズンでは抑えを務めており、復帰後に救援で重要な役割を担う可能性もあるが、現時点では先発として調整を続ける方針となっている。

items.title: Foreign hackers targeted Colorado water systems in August, governor's office says
items.author: A.J. Vicens
items.creator: A.J. Vicens
items.summary: Foreign hackers targeted and manipulated equipment in two local Colorado water systems last month, a spokesperson for Colorado Governor Jared Polis said on Friday.
items.body:
Foreign hackers targeted and manipulated equipment in two local Colorado water systems last month, a spokesperson for Colorado Governor Jared Polis said on Friday.
The incidents occurred at two privately owned utilities, each serving less than 200 people, and there was "no impact to public safety or water services," the spokesperson, Ally Sullivan, said in a statement.
Sullivan said the governor's office "cannot confirm what foreign actors may have been involved, but we are aware of ongoing efforts across the nation by an Iranian-backed group to access drinking water and wastewater systems."
The hackers managed to change equipment settings, including disabling remote access and alarms and altering pumping cycles, Sullivan said.
"These were brief incidents and the risks were quickly addressed by the providers themselves, who subsequently alerted the state," Sullivan said. "To our knowledge, treatment processes and water quality were not impacted at either provider."
The incidents, which occurred in late August, happened several weeks after a wave of cyberattacks targeting equipment in local water systems across roughly a dozen states and 100 water entities, according to an August 21 advisory from the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA).
CISA did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
Cybersecurity experts previously [USN:L6N43U1BD TEXT:"said"] the earlier attacks appeared similar to previous Iranian-linked hacking activity targeting programmable logic controllers, computer devices used to control machinery within critical infrastructure networks.
Some of the previous attacks included "degraded water operations" including changing IP addresses and turning on and setting passwords, "resulting in a loss of view, and in some cases function, of connected equipment in targeted facilities," the FBI said in a July 30 statement.
The FBI declined to comment.

items.title: ＭＬＢ＝ヤンキース、ジャッジが再びＩＬ入りへ　ふくらはぎ負傷
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１８日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［１８日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）ヤンキースは１８日、アーロン・ジャッジ外野手（３４）を右ふくらはぎの肉離れのため１０日間の負傷者リスト（ＩＬ）に入れると発表した。

ア・リーグ最優秀選手（ＭＶＰ）に３度選出されている主将のジャッジは、１６日のツインズ戦で右脚下部の張りを訴え、六回に交代。試合後には一回から違和感があり、プレーを続けようとしたものの、その後アーロン・ブーン監督に状況を伝えたと明かしていた。

ジャッジは今季、肋骨の負傷で３カ月以上離脱し、今月８日に復帰したばかり。復帰後は７試合で２３打数４安打（打率１割７分４厘）、１本塁打、３打点だった。

ＩＬ入りが１７日にさかのぼって適用される見通しで、レギュラーシーズン最終日の２７日から復帰可能となる。今季は６６試合に出場し、打率２割４分１厘、１８本塁打、４１打点を記録している。

items.title: Trump annonce un accord entre les Etats-Unis et le Danemark sur le Groenland
items.author: Gram Slattery, Erin Banco, Jacob Grønholt-Pedersen, Stine Jacobsen
items.creator: Gram Slattery, Erin Banco, Jacob Grønholt-Pedersen, Stine Jacobsen
items.summary: Les Etats-Unis, le Danemark et le Groenland ont conclu un accord permettant à Washington de développer de manière significative sa présence militaire sur l'île, a annoncé vendredi le président américain Donald Trump.
items.body:
Les Etats-Unis, le Danemark et le Groenland ont conclu un accord permettant à Washington de développer de manière significative sa présence militaire sur l'île, a annoncé vendredi le président américain Donald Trump.
Dans un message publié sur son réseau Truth Social, le locataire de la Maison blanche a indiqué qu'il serait interdit aux adversaires des Etats-Unis de construire des bases militaires au Groenland.
Donald Trump a ajouté qu'aucun ennemi des Etats-Unis ne pourrait faire d'investissements sensibles sur l'île sans avoir obtenu l'aval de Washington et que l'accord n'avait pas de date d'expiration.
"Sous ma direction, nous avons collaboré avec des représentants du Danemark et du Groenland afin de garantir que les Etats-Unis disposent à jamais de toute la latitude nécessaire pour prendre les mesures qui s'imposent au Groenland afin d'assurer et de défendre la sécurité du Groenland et des Etats-Unis", a écrit Donald Trump.
Un peu plus tôt, deux sources proches du dossier ont rapporté à Reuters que les Etats-Unis et le Danemark étaient sur le point de conclure un accord concernant le statut du Groenland, qui permettrait à l'armée américaine de renforcer sa présence sur l'île.
Donald Trump a déclaré, sans fournir de détails, que les Etats-Unis déploieraient bientôt une importante présence militaire au Groenland.
"C'est un rêve devenu réalité pour les Etats-Unis", a-t-il écrit.
Le cabinet de la Première ministre danoise a dit vendredi que l'accord renforcerait la sécurité dans l'Atlantique nord et dans l'Arctique.
Peu de détails concernant l'accord étaient connus vendredi soir.
Le secrétaire d'Etat américain Marco Rubio a déclaré dans un communiqué distinct que l'accord répondait de façon "permanente et complète" aux inquiétudes de Washington concernant la sécurité nationale.
"Le Groenland fera toujours partie de la zone de défense stratégique de l'Amérique du Nord et en exclura tout adversaire, tant sur son territoire que dans la zone environnante", a-t-il écrit.
Un responsable au sein du département d'Etat a déclaré qu'aux termes de l'accord aucun pays qui ne serait pas membre de l'Otan ne pourrait construire de base militaire au Groenland et que seuls les Etats-Unis et leurs alliés pourraient effectuer des "investissements sensibles", sans préciser lesquels.
L'accord accorde aux Etats-Unis un accès permanent au territoire danois semi-autonome, ainsi que des droits de stationnement et de survol, et il continuerait de s'appliquer même si le Groenland devenait indépendant, a précisé le responsable.

items.title: Anthropic considers releasing new AI model ahead of IPO, sources say
items.author: Echo Wang, Krystal Hu, Milana Vinn
items.creator: Echo Wang, Krystal Hu, Milana Vinn
items.summary: Anthropic is considering rolling out a new AI model to counter OpenAI’s momentum since its launch of GPT-6 Astra, according to three sources, ahead of an expected IPO and after its CEO called for an industrywide slowdown.
items.body:
Anthropic is considering rolling out a new AI model to counter OpenAI’s momentum since its launch of GPT-6 Astra, according to three sources, ahead of an expected IPO and after its CEO called for an industrywide slowdown.
The timing of a potential launch aimed at addressing competitive pressure from a direct rival follows Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's call on the global AI community to slow down the pace of releasing new capabilities to address safety concerns, the sources said.
“We must slow the pace at which we improve the capabilities of AI models,” Amodei wrote in a 3,800-word essay on September 12.
The essay, which painted a bleak picture of swarms of AI agents taking over the internet and outpacing human control, drew support from OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and SpaceX (SPCX.O) CEO Elon Musk .
OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra, [USN:L6N44V19D TEXT:"released this month"], has gained traction among businesses, prompting concerns among some investors who told Reuters they are re-evaluating Anthropic’s position as the leading provider of enterprise AI tools.
Anthropic is evaluating the safety of its next model as part of its deliberations over a release, one of the people familiar with the matter said.
Some of the discussions involve how to balance investment in releasing new models with efforts to strengthen the company’s profitability as rising interest rates make investors more focused on the timing of expected profits, said people familiar with the company’s thinking.
The debate over spending highlights the increasing pressure on the firms at the center of the AI boom to produce sustainable cash flows sooner, thanks both to rising rates and tough competition from open-source AI providers, especially in China.
Anthropic declined to comment for this story.
The potential launch would test how Anthropic can defend its enterprise market position against OpenAI while maintaining the safety-first identity that has distinguished it from competitors.
OPENAI'S GPT-6 ASTRA GAINS ENTERPRISE TRACTION OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra on September 3, touting gains in computer use, software engineering, cybersecurity and professional work. The model has received a strong response from enterprise users and developers, prompting potential Anthropic IPO investors to scrutinize whether OpenAI could begin taking share from Anthropic, which has been viewed for months as the leader in enterprise AI.
Astra accounted for about 13% of enterprise AI spending tracked by corporate expense platform Ramp, compared with about 8% for Anthropic’s Claude Fable, according to the latest data.
Astra has also pulled ahead on OpenRouter, a widely used platform that routes developer traffic across AI models. OpenRouter said its users spent more on OpenAI models than on Anthropic models last week, the first time OpenAI has led on that measure in more than two and a half years.
ANTHROPIC MAINTAINS REVENUE ADVANTAGE Some existing investors and those who expect to invest in both Anthropic's and OpenAI's IPOs said they do not believe Astra poses a significant threat to Anthropic, given the size of its lead in the market for enterprise AI tools and the amount of time it takes to unseat incumbent vendors to large companies.
Anthropic’s annualized revenue run rate topped $65 billion by the end of July, up from about $9 billion at the end of 2025. It is also projecting a 2028 revenue of roughly $190 billion to $200 billion, Reuters previously [USN:L4N44E1B2 TEXT:"reported"]. OpenAI's annualized revenue run rate passed $40 billion in July.
Investors also expect leadership among Anthropic, OpenAI, Alphabet’s (GOOGL.O) Google and other major AI developers to shift repeatedly as companies release new generations of models, making any advantage potentially short-lived.
BIGGER CHALLENGES AHEAD A potentially bigger challenge for Anthropic and other leading AI providers is the rise of open-source and open-weight models, which can lower token costs and allow companies to build more of their own AI infrastructure rather than rely on providers such as Anthropic and OpenAI, investors said.
The shift could put pressure on the economics of the AI industry as companies have more options to develop and run models outside the leading commercial providers, broadening the competitive threat beyond the race between Anthropic and OpenAI.
Meta Platforms (META.O) has been among Anthropic’s largest customers, but is looking to reduce its use of Anthropic’s models as it develops more AI capabilities internally, people familiar with the matter said. Meta did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
OpenAI, meanwhile, has taken some pressure off the race to public markets. Its CEO, Altman, confirmed on Saturday that the company [USN:L6N45500D TEXT:"would not go public in 2026"], saying concerns around AI safety made this an ill-advised time for a listing.
Anthropic could push its IPO to after the November US midterm elections, with the elections not expected to have a major impact on the offering, according to two people familiar with the matter. The IPO has already been pushed back from earlier plans, with Reuters previously reporting that marketing was expected to begin in mid-October at the earliest.

items.summary: O ministro Gilmar Mendes, do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), decidiu nesta sexta-feira que o reajuste concedido pelo presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva ao Bolsa Família a menos de 20 dias do primeiro turno da eleição presidencial é regular e não fere a legislação eleitoral.
items.body:
O ministro Gilmar Mendes, do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), decidiu nesta sexta-feira que o reajuste concedido pelo presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva ao Bolsa Família a menos de 20 dias do primeiro turno da eleição presidencial é regular e não fere a legislação eleitoral.
Na decisão proferida em resposta a um pedido da Advocacia-Geral da União (AGU), o magistrado afirma que a utilização do INPC como critério utilizado para o reajuste em 15,04% não viola as proibições previstas na legislação eleitoral e apenas recompõe a inflação.
O ministro também faz questão de diferenciar a correção promovida pelo governo Lula do aumento concedido pelo ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro, também às vésperas das eleições de 2022, o qual "previu a ampliação temporária de benefícios, criação de novas prestações, antecipação do calendário de pagamentos e expressivo aumento do número de famílias atendidas -- tudo restrito ao período de agosto a dezembro de 2022, ano eleitoral".
"A providência adotada corresponde, portanto, à atualização periódica dos valores prevista no marco legal que disciplina atualmente a política pública e que já foi reconhecido por esta corte como instrumento de concretização da ordem proferida nestes autos", diz Gilmar, na decisão desta sexta-feira.
"Além disso, a medida não importa criação de novo benefício, alteração dos critérios de elegibilidade ou ampliação do universo de beneficiários. Trata-se apenas de atualização dos valores das prestações integrantes de programa social já existente, mediante critério objetivo de correção monetária."
Com o reajuste anunciado, o piso do Bolsa Família passará de R$600 para R$691, enquanto o valor médio do benefício do programa irá para R$777. Segundo cálculos da equipe econômica do governo Lula, o impacto fiscal será de R$5,8 bilhões neste ano e de R$22 bilhões no ano que vem.
O governo, que disse que enviará ao Congresso mensagem alterando a lei orçamentária de 2027 para incluir o reajuste, afirmou que a medida não gerará aumento de despesas, mas sim remanejamento, e que há espaço fiscal para conceder o reajuste.
Na quinta-feira, o candidato à Presidência pelo Missão, Renan Santos, pediu ao Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE) que suspendesse o reajuste de 15% nos benefícios do Bolsa Família sob o argumento de que a medida, tomada a menos de 20 dias do primeiro turno da eleição presidencial, é ilegal, inconstitucional e "desequilibra definitivamente o pleito".

items.title: Father of murdered Spanish student arrives in Mexico after suspect detained
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The father of a Spanish exchange student killed in Mexico arrived in the Mexican state of Morelos on Friday to identify his daughter's body, a day after authorities detained a suspect in her murder.
items.body:
The father of a Spanish exchange student killed in Mexico arrived in the Mexican state of Morelos on Friday to identify his daughter's body, a day after authorities detained a suspect in her murder.
Claudia Tacoronte, a 21-year-old student, died from stab wounds on September 12 in the city of Cuautla after someone tried to steal her cellphone, Mexican authorities have said.
On Thursday evening, authorities announced they had arrested a suspect, identified as Francisco Javier "N."
The case has caused [USN:L6N45614F TEXT:"widespread anger"] in both Mexico and Spain, with students demanding stronger protections for women. Mexico has long struggled with high levels of gender-based violence.
Spanish newspaper El Pais, citing sources close to the investigation, reported that the suspect had confessed to the killing.
The killing is being treated as a femicide, or a killing motivated by gender, the state prosecutor in Morelos said.
Morelos recorded 21 femicides between January and July this year, according to official data, while 380 were registered across Mexico over the same period.
The suspect was due to appear before a judge on Friday afternoon. Fernando Blumenkron, Morelos' state prosecutor, said his office would seek the maximum penalty for femicide — 70 years in prison.
Blumenkron told journalists that the suspect attacked Tacoronte outside a cultural building where she had been attending a conference and staying. The prosecutor said the suspect had a police record for burglaries, and had spent time behind bars.
Tacoronte was a student at Spain's University of Granada and had arrived in mid-August on an exchange program at the Autonomous University of the State of Morelos.
At least four female students at the same Mexican university have been killed in Morelos this year, according to student protesters, and Spain's Foreign Ministry has urged citizens to avoid non-essential travel to the state, citing rising drug-related violence and kidnappings.
The University of Granada has also canceled exchange placements for three students who had been due to study in Morelos next semester.

items.title: Two hospital systems settle US probe over transgender care billing for $9.5 million
items.author: Steve Gorman
items.creator: Steve Gorman
items.summary: Two major US hospital systems have agreed to pay nearly $9.5 million combined to settle a US Department of Justice probe into claims that the medical centers were improperly billing for gender-affirming care provided to minors, the department said on Friday.
items.body:
Two major US hospital systems have agreed to pay nearly $9.5 million combined to settle a US Department of Justice probe into claims that the medical centers were improperly billing for gender-affirming care provided to minors, the department said on Friday.
Under the agreements, the New York University Langone Health system and University of Pittsburgh Medical Center will cease providing such transgender-related care as puberty blockers, hormone treatments and surgical procedures to patients under age 18, the department said.
In separate statements, both institutions said the agreement also safeguards the confidentiality of patients, legal guardians and providers whose privacy was threatened by grand jury subpoenas that the Justice Department had issued as part of its investigation.
Moreover, the two healthcare systems said their agreements include express denials of any wrongdoing or liability. Pediatric mental health programs and gender-affirming care for patients 18 and older will continue, they said.
The Justice Department said NYU Langone agreed to pay $8.5 million as part of its settlement, while Pittsburgh's UPMC will pay $950,000.
"We believe this resolution is in the best interests of our patients and their families, protecting them as well as our providers and the institution from prolonged litigation," NYU Langone said in a statement.
UPMC expressed the same rationale.
In the case of NYU Langone, one of New York City's leading hospital networks, the institution already had discontinued its program for treating transgender youth in February, citing the "current regulatory environment."
UPMC did not address the prevailing status of its transgender youth health program.
The settlement stems from a broader campaign by President Donald Trump and his administration to end gender-affirming medical treatments for children who experience an innate sense of self that conflicts with their birth sex, a condition called gender dysphoria.
A key part of Trump's crackdown has comprised investigations by the Justice Department and US Department of Health and Human Services accusing dozens of hospitals and healthcare providers of fraudulently billing for gender-affirming care.
The inquiries have alleged that providers routinely submit claims under false disorder diagnoses to obtain reimbursements from both private and government-sponsored health plans.
There is wide agreement among mainstream medical and mental health professionals that gender-affirming care saves lives by reducing the risk of depression and suicide among transgender youth.
Opponents of transgender healthcare interventions say the long-term effects are not fully understood and that youths are too young to make such life-altering choices, even with parental supervision.
The Trump administration finalized a rule last month barring two major federal healthcare programs from funding gender-affirming medical care.
The Justice Department said Friday's announcement followed similar agreements reached with Mount Sinai Health System in New York, Texas Children's Hospital, the Cleveland Clinic Foundation and Connecticut Children's Hospital. It said all parties have agreed to keep precise details of Friday's settlement terms confidential.

items.summary: Energy Capital Partners-backed ProEnergy is seeking a valuation of as much as $50 billion in a US initial public offering, Bloomberg News reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter.
items.body:
Energy Capital Partners-backed ProEnergy is seeking a valuation of as much as $50 billion in a US initial public offering, Bloomberg News reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter.
Here are some additional details:
The IPO could value ProEnergy, which makes power generation equipment, at around $40 billion to $50 billion, depending on the market, the report said, adding that ECP could also consider selling ProEnergy.
ECP acquired a majority stake in ProEnergy in September 2024.
The Missouri-headquartered firm is working with Morgan Stanley and JPMorgan Chase on the IPO process, the report said.
ECP declined to comment, while ProEnergy, Morgan Stanley and JPMorgan did not immediately respond to Reuters' requests for comment outside regular business hours.

items.title: Trump se reunirá com presidente interina da Venezuela em Nova York na terça-feira
items.author: Humeyra Pamuk, Steve Holland
items.creator: Humeyra Pamuk, Steve Holland
items.summary: O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, se reunirá com a presidente interina da Venezuela, Delcy Rodríguez, em Nova York na terça-feira, informou uma autoridade sênior norte-americana nesta sexta-feira, no que será o primeiro encontro presencial entre os dois líderes desde que Washington destituiu o ex-presidente venezuelano Nicolás Maduro, em janeiro.
items.body:
O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, se reunirá com a presidente interina da Venezuela, Delcy Rodríguez, em Nova York na terça-feira, informou uma autoridade sênior norte-americana nesta sexta-feira, no que será o primeiro encontro presencial entre os dois líderes desde que Washington destituiu o ex-presidente venezuelano Nicolás Maduro, em janeiro.
O encontro de Trump com Rodríguez, ex-vice de Maduro, ocorrerá à margem de uma recepção que o presidente republicano oferecerá, disse o embaixador dos EUA na ONU, Mike Waltz, a repórteres em uma teleconferência.
“O presidente oferecerá uma recepção aos líderes da Assembleia Geral da ONU. Lá, ele participará de uma conversa à parte com a presidente interina Rodríguez, da Venezuela”, disse Waltz. Ele não deu detalhes sobre o que eles possam discutir.
O Ministério da Comunicação da Venezuela, responsável por todas as consultas da imprensa ao governo, não respondeu imediatamente a um pedido de comentário.
No mês passado, os EUA e a Venezuela assinaram um acordo energético que permitiria aos EUA assumir o controle parcial das vastas reservas de petróleo da Venezuela, apostando que empresas norte-americanas possam ajudar a revitalizar o setor energético abalado do país sul-americano.
A líder da oposição venezuelana María Corina Machado enfrenta um dilema crescente sobre quando retornar ao país para angariar apoio, em meio à reticência do governo Trump em relação ao seu retorno.
Machado deixou o país no final do ano passado para receber o Prêmio Nobel da Paz, depois de ter vivido praticamente na clandestinidade desde a disputada eleição de 2024. Ela procurou conquistar Trump como aliado muito antes da destituição de Maduro. Mas, desde a destituição, Trump tem repetidamente expressado apoio a Rodríguez.

items.title: Coreia do Norte afirma que seu status nuclear é “irreversível” após repreensão da agência nuclear da ONU
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Kim Yo Jong, a poderosa irmã do líder norte-coreano, Kim Jong Un, acusou a Agência Internacional de Energia Atômica (AIEA) no sábado (horário local) de aplicar dois pesos e duas medidas, depois que a agência aprovou uma resolução criticando o programa de armas nucleares de Pyongyang.
items.body:
Kim Yo Jong, a poderosa irmã do líder norte-coreano, Kim Jong Un, acusou a Agência Internacional de Energia Atômica (AIEA) no sábado (horário local) de aplicar dois pesos e duas medidas, depois que a agência aprovou uma resolução criticando o programa de armas nucleares de Pyongyang.
O “ponto de vista tendencioso e o duplo padrão” da AIEA são “o fator fundamental que está causando o colapso do sistema internacional de não proliferação nuclear”, afirmou Kim Yo Jong em comunicado divulgado pela agência de notícias estatal KCNA.
Ela afirmou que a agência fechou os olhos às “atividades flagrantes de proliferação nuclear” dos Estados Unidos e ao “plano de introdução de submarinos nucleares” da Coreia do Sul, ao mesmo tempo em que aprovou à força uma resolução contra as “atividades nucleares legítimas e de autodefesa” da Coreia do Norte.
Em um comunicado separado da KCNA, o Ministério das Relações Exteriores da Coreia do Norte também rejeitou a resolução, declarando que seu status como potência nuclear é irreversível e respaldado por sua força de dissuasão nuclear.
A KCNA informou ainda que o líder norte-coreano Kim Jong Un realizou, nesta semana, uma visita de inspeção de três dias às principais fábricas de munições.
Kim enfatizou que a artilharia da Coreia do Norte deve tanto combater quanto dissuadir a guerra com “a capacidade ofensiva mais concentrada e destrutiva, maciça e versátil”, informou a KCNA.
Kim acrescentou que os esforços da Coreia do Norte para modernizar todos os componentes de sua capacidade de defesa estão provocando “uma mudança significativa” na composição e nos meios de suas Forças Armadas.
Analistas afirmam que a Coreia do Norte vem reformulando suas Forças Armadas com a ajuda da Rússia desde que os dois países assinaram um tratado de defesa mútua em 2024. Eles afirmam que a experiência de combate adquirida pelas tropas de Pyongyang enviadas para a guerra na Ucrânia também contribuiu para esse esforço.

items.title: Canceled qualifying puts Kyle Larson on pole for Bristol Night Race
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: BRISTOL, Tenn. -- Just nine points out of the Chase lead, Kyle Larson will start from the pole position in Saturday's Bass Pro Shops Night Race, after a lightning delay forced cancellation of Friday's qualifying session at Bristol Motor Speedway.
items.body:
BRISTOL, Tenn. -- Just nine points out of the Chase lead, Kyle Larson will start from the pole position in Saturday's Bass Pro Shops Night Race, after a lightning delay forced cancellation of Friday's qualifying session at Bristol Motor Speedway.
Having finished fifth in the Chase opener at Darlington Raceway before winning last Sunday at World Wide Technology Raceway, Larson brings considerable momentum to the third race of the NASCAR Cup Series postseason (7:30 p.m. ET Saturday on USA Network, PRN and SiriusXM NASCAR Radio).
"Always coming into here I feel confident," said Larson, driver of the No. 5 Hendrick Motorsports Chevrolet. "I do believe we can come here and have a good weekend. At Darlington, I felt like we were back to being ‘5-team-ish' in a way. It had been so long since we were battling for a win... So that was fun."
"To go to Gateway and put on a performance like we did, yeah, I felt like we were getting closer to where we want to be, but still have room to go, for sure -- a lot of room to go to be dominant. But at least as far as team prep, execution and all the things it takes, I felt like these first two weeks have gone really strong."
Chase drivers occupy the first five positions on the starting grid for the Night Race, with Joey Logano lining up next to Larson on the first row in a field set by the rule book (according to metrics) because of the cancellation.
Top seed and Chase leader Denny Hamlin will start third, as he tries to keep Larson at bay. William Byron lines up fourth, followed by Carson Hocevar. Non-Chase drivers Alex Bowman and Ross Chastain will start sixth and seventh, followed by Chase driver Austin Cindric.
Non-Chaser Austin Dillon starts ninth with Chase driver Bubba Wallace 10th on the grid.
Other Chase drivers start as follows: Christopher Bell 12th, Ty Gibbs 13th, Ryan Preece 16th, Tyler Reddick 20th, Chris Buescher 23rd, Chase Briscoe 26th, Chase Elliott 27th, Daniel Suarez 28th and Ryan Blaney 29th.
Bell is third in the Chase standings, 18 points behind Hamlin. Suarez is currently on baby watch for his first child, with NASCAR O'Reilly Auto Parts Series driver Justin Allgaier on standby for possible relief duties.
"Hopefully, the baby doesn't come till Sunday or Monday," Suarez said. "I think it's going to come very soon though. Hopefully, it's not tomorrow."

items.title: Trump to meet with Venezuela's interim president Rodriguez in New York on Tuesday
items.author: Humeyra Pamuk, Steve Holland
items.creator: Humeyra Pamuk, Steve Holland
items.summary: US President Donald Trump will have a meeting with Venezuela's interim President Delcy Rodriguez in New York on Tuesday, a senior US official said on Friday, in what will be the first in-person meeting between the two leaders since Washington ousted former Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro in January.
items.body:
US President Donald Trump will have a meeting with Venezuela's interim President Delcy Rodriguez in New York on Tuesday, a senior US official said on Friday, in what will be the first in-person meeting between the two leaders since Washington ousted former Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro in January.
Trump's meeting with Rodriguez, Maduro's former deputy, will be on the sidelines of a reception that the Republican president will be hosting, US ambassador to the UN Mike Waltz told reporters in a briefing call.
"The president will host a UN General Assembly leaders' reception. There, he'll participate in a pull-aside with the acting president Rodriguez of Venezuela," Waltz said. He did not give any details of what they might discuss.
The Venezuelan communications ministry, which handles all press queries for the government, did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
Last month, the US and Venezuela signed an [USN:FWN44P1ZC TEXT:"energy agreement"] that would allow the US to take partial control of Venezuela's vast oil reserves, betting that American companies can help revive the South American nation's battered energy industry.
Venezuelan opposition leader [USN:L6N45311X TEXT:"Maria Corina Machado"] is facing a growing dilemma over when to return home to rally support amid reticence from the Trump administration about her homecoming.
Machado left the country late last year to receive the Nobel Peace Prize, after largely living in hiding since a contested 2024 election. She sought to cultivate Trump as an ally well before Maduro's removal. But since the ouster, Trump has repeatedly expressed support for Rodriguez.

items.title: Soccer-Women's Bundesliga to be run by independent body from next season
items.summary: The German Football Association, DFB, has leased the organising rights of the top-tier Women's Bundesliga to an independent body run by clubs for seven years starting next season, delegates in the ...
items.body:
Soccer-Women's Bundesliga to be run by independent body from next season
Reuters | Updated: 19-09-2026 11:45 IST | Created: 19-09-2026 11:45 IST

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

The German Football Association, DFB, has leased the organising rights of the top-tier Women's Bundesliga to an independent body run by clubs for seven years starting next season, delegates in the DFB's legislative body decided by unanimous vote on Friday. The 14 Women's Bundesliga clubs agreed to split from the DFB in December, forming the Women's Bundesliga Association, or FBL e.V., which will take over the league from July 2027.
"The new model is broadly based on the structure in men’s football regarding the relationship between the DFB and the Bundesliga. Unlike in men’s football, however, the Women’s Bundesliga 2 remains under the umbrella of the DFB," the DFB said in a statement. England's top-flight Women's Super League made a similar move to independent governance from 2024, seeking commercial autonomy and specialised professional growth.
"The spin-off ... is in line with the wishes of the clubs and the FBL e.V. The delegates have today acted on this wish, and I very much welcome that," said DFB Vice President Heike Ullrich. The FBL e.V. will receive €1.4 million ($1.6 million) annually from the DFB, with the amount increasing by €200,000 in years when the Women's European Championship or the Women's World Cup is held, plus half of the profit generated by the women's national team's participation in the tournaments.
($1 = 0.8709 euros)

items.title: Trump declines to say whether he will tear down Kennedy Center
items.author: Jacob Bogage , Steve Holland
items.creator: Jacob Bogage , Steve Holland
items.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump on Friday refused to say whether he would attempt to demolish the John F. Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts, the iconic facility on Washington's Potomac River.
items.body:
U.S. President Donald Trump on Friday refused to say whether he would attempt to demolish the John F. Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts, the iconic facility on Washington's Potomac River.
Speaking from the Oval Office, Trump repeated his belief that the center should append his name to the building in exchange for his work to raise money to renovate the facility. He falsely claimed the center faced long-term financial strains that required dramatic action, although the facility posted profits in seven of the past nine years, according to its tax filings.
"I think the Trump administration should be recognized as having saved the Kennedy Center because nobody else remembers," Trump said.
The Kennedy Center board, which has said the facility requires a $257 million renovation, earlier this week voted to close the facility for two years for the project. US District Judge Christopher Cooper [USN:L6N45813A TEXT:"subsequently ordered"] the Trump administration to explain whether the closure violates a court order limiting its ability to shut down.
Cooper also ordered the administration to [USN:L6N4590UE TEXT:"provide 30 days' notice"] before taking steps to demolish the building.
"President Trump is holding the Kennedy Center hostage," said Norm Eisen and Nathaniel Zelinsky, attorneys representing U.S. Representative Joyce Beatty, an Ohio Democrat and ex-officio member of the center's board who is leading litigation against the administration over its plans for the facility.
Representatives for the center did not immediately respond to a request for comment on Friday.
The board, chaired by Trump and controlled by his appointees, earlier this year attempted to rename the facility the "Trump-Kennedy Center" and went so far as to add the president's name to the building. After Cooper ruled that only Congress could rename the center, the board installed a tarp over the front facade of the building that has remained there as the legal fight continues.
Trump told reporters on Friday that adding his name to the building would be a show of "bipartisanship," because Trump is a Republican and Kennedy, who was assassinated in 1963, was a Democrat.
He called Cooper "hostile," and described the center — which features a concert hall, opera house, theater and 12 additional performance and meeting spaces — as a "dump."
